details.body: GABARDINE: sTUlamAprapadInam (?); *govarDanam.
GABARDINE , s. sTUlaSAwakaH, sTUlaSAwI, grAByajanaBftaM SiTilottarIyaM.
GABBLE: jalpati (jalp, c. 1.): v. To Babble, chatter.
To GABBLE , v. n. jalp (c. 1. jalpati -lpituM), upajalp, pralap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), anarTakavAkyam udIr (c. 10. -Irayati -yituM), anarTakaSabdaM kf, vfTASavwaM kf.
GABBLE , s. jalpaH -lpanA -lpitaM, prajalpaH, pralApaH, nirarTakaSabdaH, cItkAraH.
GABBLER: jalpAkaH (kI, kaM): v. Babbler.
GABBLER , s. jalpakaH, jalpAkaH, upajalpI m. (n), anarTakaSabdakArI m. (n).
Gabel, s. karaH, rAjasvaM, SulkaH-lkaM, baliH.
GABEL , s. SulkaH -lkaM, karaH, rAjagrAhyaBAgaH, rAjadeyo BAgaH, rAjasvaM.
Gaberdine, s. varASiH, sTUlaSAwakaH.
GABION: *gopakaH; Satroragnergopako mfdgarBaH karaRqaviSezaH.
GABION , s. yudDe SatruprakziptagolanivArako mfttikAgarBaH karaRqaviSezaH.
Gable, s. gfha-prAsAda-SiKaraM.
GABLE: trikoRaSiras (n.) (?). G. window: trikoRa- vAtAyanam (?).
GABLE , GABLE-END, s. gfhaSfNgaM, prAsAdaSfNgaM, gfhaSiKaraM, vaqaBiH f.
Gad, s. bARAgraM, SUlAgraM; agraM, karRaH. 2 kIlaH, lohakIlaH. v. i. aw 1 P, pariBram 1, 4 P. [Gad]ding, s. pari-, awanaM-BramaRaM.
GAD (subs.): I Of a weapon: agram, g. of an arrow: bARAgram.II A spike or wedge: kIlaH.
GAD (v.i.): awati (aw, c. 1.): v. To roam, wander.
GAD , s. (Head of a spear or arrow) SUlAgraM, vARAgraM. — (Wedge of steel or iron) tIkzRAyasakIlaH, lohakIlaH.
To GAD ABOUT , v. n. aw (c. 1. awati -wituM), paryyaw, Bram (c. 1. Bramati, c. 4. BrAmyati, BramituM), pariBram, aw in freq. (awAwyate), itastato vicar (c. 1. -carati -rituM).
GADDER: vfTABramaRakArin (f. RI): v. Rambler.
GADDER , s. awanakArI m. (n), paryyawanakft, BramaRakArI m., avanicaraH.
GADDING ABOUT , s. awanaM, paryyawanaM, BramaRaM, pariBramaRaM, vrajyA, viharaRaM.
Gad-fly, s. daMSakaH, gomakzikA, daMSaH-SI, vanamakzikA.
GADFLY: (1) daMSaH, -SI;(2) daMSakaH;(3) gomakzikA.
GADFLY , s. daMSaH -SI, daMSakaH, vanamakzikA, araRyamakzikA, gomakzikA, nIlANguH m., pAMSuraH.
GAFF , s. (Light spear used by fishermen) laGuSUlaH, DIvarI. — (For extending sails) nOkAvasanaprasAraRArTaM yazWiH m. f.
Gaffer, s. vfdDajanaH, aSizwAcAraH.
GAFFER , s. sADujanaH, AryyakaH, AryyamARavakaH, tapasvI m. (n),
Gag, s. muKabaMDanI-piDAnaM, roDanaM. v. t. muKaM baMD 9 P or niruD 7 U or pi-DA 3 U.
GAG (subs.): (1) muKabanDanI;(2) muKaroDanam (?), etc.
GAG (v.): muKaM baDnAti (banD, c. 9.), ruRadDi. ni-, (ruD, c. 7.).
To GAG , v. a. muKaM banD (c. 9. vaDnAti, banDuM) or pratibanD or ruD (c. 7. ruRadDi, rodDaM) or niruD or pratiruD or piDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM).
GAG , s. muKaroDanaM, muKavanDanI, muKaprativanDakaM, muKapiDAnaM.
Gage, s. paRaH, ADiH, paripaRanaM. 2 mAnaM, pra-pari-mARaM. 3 mApanayaMtraM. 4 AhvAnaM. v. i. paR 1 A, pratijYA 9 U, aMgIkf 8 U, pratipad 4 A, saSapaTaM pratijYA.
GAGE (subs.): I Pledge: q.v.: banDakaH.II A challenge to combat.: perh. kzepaH, “there I throw my g.”: atrAhaM kzepaM kzipAmi.

GAGE , s. (Pledge) paRaH, paripaRanaM, pratipARaM, ADiH m., banDakaH. — (Challenge) AhvAnaM. — (Measure) parimARaM, parimARaviDiH m., parimARarItiH f., pramARaM, mAnaM. — (Instrument for measuring) mApanayantraM, parimApanayantraM; ‘rain-gage,’ vfzwimApanayantraM.
To GAGE , v. a. (Pledge) paR (c. 1. paRate -RituM), paRaM kf, pratijYA (c. 9. -jAnIte -jYAtuM), aNgIkf. — (Bind by pledge) paRena banD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM). — (Measure). See GUAGE.
Gaggle, v. i. kalaM ru 2 P; kUj 1 P.
To GAGGLE , v. n. haMsanAdaM kf, haMsavat kUj (c. 1. kUjati -jituM).
GAGGLING: Of geese: (1) haMsanAdaH; haMsanisvanaH, Ki.;(2) marAlakUjitam, M. n.
GAGGLING , s. haMsanAdaH, haMsarutaM, haMsakUjanaM, kajanaM.
GAIETY: (1) AmodaH;(2) pramodaH: v. Mirth, cheerfulness.
GAILY: I Cheerfully: sollAsam.II Beauti- -fully: sundaram.

GAILY , adv. (Joyfully) saharzaM, sAnandaM, hfzwamanasA, praPullamanasA, prasannacetasA, pramodena. — (Splendidly) atiSoBanaM, SoBanaM, saSoBaM; ‘gaily dressed,’ SoBanaveSI -SinI -Si (n), ujjvalaveSaDArI -riRI -ri (n).

Gain, v. i. laB 1 A, arj 1 P or c., Ap 5 P, A-samA-sad c.; See Get; ‘g(ain) ground’ upa-ci pass., pravfD 1 A; praruh 1 P; ‘g(ain) over’ sAD c., vaSaM nI 1 P (DanadAnAdinA); anuraMj c., grah 9 U; ‘g(ain) over to oneʼs side’ svapakzaM grah c.; ‘g(ain) a battle’ yudDe jayaM laB; ‘g(ain) the day’ jayaM prAp, vijayin a. BU; ‘g(ain) upon oneʼs steps’ samAsad c.; See Overtake. v. t. kramaSaH prasfp or pragam 1 P. s. lABaH, prApti f., PalaM, AyaH, arTaH, utpannaM, PalodayaH, arjanaM. [Gain]er, s. arjakaH; prAptalABaH; PalaprApakaH. [Gain]ful, a. Palada; lABajanaka, arTotpAdaka. [Gainful]ly, adv. dakzaM, caturaM, sapAwavaM.

GAIN (subs.): (1) lABaH, are the g. s of your business thriving: api pracIyante saMvyvahArARAM lABA vaH, Mu. i.; participating good g. s: uttamalABaBAj (min.), Si. iii. 76.;(2) vfdDiH (= increase), considering g. and loss: vfdDikzayO vicArya, M. viii. 401.

GAIN (v.t.): I To obtain, acquire: q.v.: laBate (laB, c. 1.), g. ed by knowledge: vidyayA labDa (f. bDA), Y.; if you again g. your place: yadi labDaM punarAtmanaH padam, Ki.II To be successful in: jayati (ji, c. 1.), to g. a battle: yudDaM jayati or yudDe jayaM laBate; one who g.s a case: jayin (f. nI), Mit. III To arrive at: q.v.: prApnoti (Ap, c. 5.). IV Of time: it g. s an hour a day: *pratyaha- masyekA GawikA varDate (vfD, c. 1.) or upacIyate (pass. of ci). Ph: to g. ground: upa-cIyate, pra-.
GAIN , s. lABaH, labDiH f., prAptiH f., PalaM, arjjanaM, upArjjanaM, laByaM, laByAMSaH, pratipattiH f., AyaH, PalodayaH, arTaH, utpannaM, paRyaPalatvaM, yogakzemaH, vfdDiH f., vivfdDiH f., prayogaH.

To GAIN , v. a. (Obtain, acquire) arj (c. 10. arjayati -yituM), upArj; laB (c. 1. laBate, labDuM), upalaB, Ap (c. 5. Apnoti, AptuM), prAz samprAp, avAp, samAp; Asad (c. 10. -sAdayati -yituM), samAsad, aDigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), gam, pratipad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), Apad, AviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), samAviS, aS (c. 5. aSnute, aSituM), samaS, upAS, vid (c. 6. vindati, vettuM, vedituM), aBivid, prativid, i (c. 2. eti -tuM), svIkf. — (Gain by conquest) nirji (c. 1. -jagrati -jetuM). — (Gain over) anuraYj (c. 10. -raYjayati -yituM), prasAD (c. 10. -sADa- yati -yituM); ‘to one's own party,’ AtmapakzIkf. — (Gain ground) vfD (c. 1. varDate -rDituM), praBU.

To GAIN , v. n. (Have advantage) lABaM kf, PalaM kf. — (Grow rich, prosper) samfdDIBU, samfD (c. 5. -fDnoti -arDituM), vfD (c. 1. varDate -rDituM). — (Advance on, encroach) krame krame prasfp (c. 1. -sarpati -sraptuM) or pragam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM). — (Prevail against) atiric in pass. (-ricyate), aBiBU, praBU, ji (c. 1. jayati, jetuM).
GAIN ON or UPON: “g. ed u. the Venetains” *vEnasikeByaH vfdDiM prApuH; “so far g. ed on the emperor”: *aDirAjamIdfganukUlIcakAra.
GAIN OVER: DanadAnAdinA AtmIyaM (f. yAM) karoti.
GAINABLE , a. prApyaH -pyA -pyaM, laByaH -ByA -ByaM, AsAdanIyaH -yA -yaM.

GAINED , p. p. prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, AptaH -ptA -ptaM, avAptaH -ptA -ptaM, labDaH -bDA -bDaM, arjjitaH -tA -taM, upArjjitaH -tA -qaM, mAsAditaH -tA -taM, samAsAditaH -tA -taM, aDigataH -tA -taM, ApannaH -nnA -nnaM, upAttaH -ttA -ttaM, kalitaH -tA -taM; ‘gained with difficulty,’ kfcCrAptaH -ptA -ptaM.
GAINER , s. arjayitA m. (tf), arjakaH, upArjakaH, prApakaH, PalaprApakaH, labDA (bDf).
GAINFUL: lAmakaraH (rI, raM): v. Profitable.
GAINFUL , a. PalI -linI -li (n), PaladaH -dA -daM, saPalaH -lA -laM, arTakaraH -rI -raM, arTadaH -dA -daM, lABajanakaH -kA -kaM, prAptijanakaH -kA -kaM.
GAINFULLY , adv. saPalaM, salABaM, sArTaM, lABena, Palodayena.
GAINFULNESS , s. saPalatA, salABatA, sArTatvaM, lABaH, labDiH f., prAptiH f.
GAINLESS: alABaH (BA, BaM): v. Unprofitable.
GAINLY , adv. dakzaM, sadAkzyaM, yuktyA, sapAwavaM, caturaM, paryyAptaM.
Gainsay, v. t. viruD 7 U; ni-prati-ziD 1 P, pratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P, apavad 1 U, apalap 1 P, aDarIkf 8 U, nirA-kf, bAD 1 A, niras 4 U. [Gainsay]er, s. apavAdakaH, nizeDakaH.
GAINSAY: pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.): v. To con- -tradict.

To GAINSAY , v. a. viparItaM vad (c. 1. vadati -te -dituM), vivad, apavad, pratyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), antaHKyA, apalap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), viruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM), aDarIkf, bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM).
GAINSAYED , p. p. pratyAKyAtaH -tA -taM, apahnutaH -tA -taM, bADitaH -tA -taM.
GAINSAYER , s. viparItavAdI m. (n), pratyAKyAtA m. (tf), apavAdakaH, vivAdI m. (n), prativAdI m., viroDI m. (n), viGnakArI m. (n).
Gairish, a. atiSoBana, rUpagarvita. [Gairish]ness, s. atiSoBA, rUpagarvaH, daMBaH.
GAIRISH , a. atiSoBanaH -nA -naM, ekAntaSoBanaH -nA -naM, SoBAmAtrasevI -vinI -vi (n), alaNkarizRuH -zRuH -zRu, dAmBikaH -kI -kaM, rUpADmAtaH -tA -taM.
GAIRISHLY , adv. atiSoBanaM, ekAntaSoBApUrvvaM, rUpADmAtavat, sadamBaM, dAmBikavata.
GAIRISHNESS , s. atiSoBA, ekAntaSoBA, damBaH, dAmBikatvaM, rUpADmAtatvaM.
Gait, s. gati f. gamanaM, gataM, cAraH; ‘graceful in g(ait)’ haMsagati, cArugAmin.
GAIT: (1) gatiH;(2) calanam;(3) gamanam as in gajagamanaH (nA, naM).
GAIT , s. gatiH f., gamanaM, gataM, cAraH, caraRaM, calanaM, saraRaM, vrajanaM, ayanaM; ‘graceful in gait,’ sugaH -gA -gaM -gAmI -minI -mi (n), SuBagaH -gA -gaM, haMsagAmI &c., cAracaRaH -RA -RaM.
GAITER: gulPatrARam (?).
GAITER , s. sTUlavastramayaM, jaNGAtrARaM or jaNGArakzaRaM, jaNGottarIyaM.
Gala, s. utsavaH, utsavadivasaH, parvadinaM.
GALA , s. utsavaH -vadinaM, mahotsavaH, parvva n. (n), parvvAhaH, udDarzaH.
GALA-DAY: (1) utsavadinam;(2) pramodadivasaH; etc.
GALACTOPHAGIST , s. kzIrapaH -pAyI m. (n), dugDayaH, payasyaH, kzIrAdaH, kzIrASI m. (n).
Galaxy, s. suranadI, AkASagaMgA, svargaMgA, viyadgaMgA. 2 suvastumaMqalaM.
GALAXY: I The milky-way: suranadI.II A spendidsplendid assemblage “of g. poets”: mahAkavInAM samAgamaH.
GALAXY , s. (Milky way) mandAkinI, AkASagaNgA, svargaNgA, nAgavITI, haritAlI. — (Assemblage of splendid objects) SoBanavastumaRqalaM, supraBavastusamUhaH.
GALBAN, GALBANUM: *gAlvanam; niryAsaviSezaH.
Gale, s. vAtaH, vAyuH, pavanaH; ‘strong g(ale)’ vAtyA, vAtAlI, caMqavAtaH, javAnilaH, vegAnilaH, prakaMpanaH, vrAji f.
GALE: vAtaH, hard g.: caRqavAtaH: v. Wind, breeze.

GALE , s. pravalavAyuH m., pracaRqavAyuH m., ativAtaH, vAtyA, vAtyAvegaH, caRqavAtaH, vAtAlI, vAtarUpaH, vAtagulmaH, JaYJAvAtaH, JaYJA, pavanaH, pavanAGAtaH, javAnilaH, DrAjiH f., vrAjiH f., karIpaNkazA, PaH; ‘tossed by gales,’ pavanakziptaH -ptA -ptaM, pavanavegakziptaH -ptA -ptaM.
GALIOT , s. SIGragAmI laGunOkAviSezaH.

Gall, s. kzataM, vizaM; daMSaH; (fig.) pIqA, duzwaBAvaH, saMbADA. 2 pittaM, mAyuH. 3 kawutA, tigmatA, kaWoratA, aruMtudatvaM. v. t. carma Gfz 1 P or kfz 1 P. 2 saM-pari-tap c., pIq 10, bAD 1 A, kliS 9 P, ard 1 P, marmARi kft 6 P or Bid 7 P. v. i. AtmAnaM tap c. [Gall]ing, a. paruza, marmacCid-Bid, aruMtuda.

GALL (subs.): I The bile: pittam, g.-bladder: pittASayaH.II Spite, malignity: q.v.: vizam (= poison). Ph.: to add g. to bitterness: kzate kzAraM kzipati, P.III A sore by rubbing: kzatam (gen. term),IV Of a tree: malam (?).
GALL (v.t.): I To chafe: GarzaRena kziRoti (kzi, c. 5.).II To tease, vex: q.v.: bADate (bAD, c. 1.)

GALL , s. (Bitter fluid, bile) pittaM, tiktapittaM, mAyuH m. — (Rancour) vizaM, vizahfdayatvaM, kAlakUwaM, daMSaH, duzwaBAvaH, durbudDiH f., drohaH, dvepaH, kawutA, tIkzRatA, tigmatA, ugratvaM, aruntudatvaM, kaWoratA, kroDaH. — (Ex- -crescence on a tree) vfkzaPenaH -nakaH.

To GALL , v. a. (Excoriate by friction) GarzaRena carmmakzataM kf or tvakCedaM kf or tvagulleKanaM kf, carmma Gfz (c. 1. Garzati -rzituM) or kfz (c. 10. karpayati -yituM). — (Vex, harass) tap (c. 10. tApayati -yituM), paritap, santap, pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM), aBipIq, ApIq, kliS (c. 9. kliSnAti, klezwuM), vAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM), ard (c. 10. ardayati -yituM), samard, marmmapIqAM kf, aruntudaH -dA -daM BU.
To GALL , v. n. (Vex one's self) AtmAnaM tap (c. 10. tApayati -yituM), or pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM) or vAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM), paritapa in pass. (-tapyate).
GALL-BLADDER , s. pittAGAraH, tiktapittADAraH, tiktapittASayaH
GALL-FLY: latAmakzikA (after gomakzikA).
GALL-NUT , s. masIjalakaraRe prayuktaH PalAkAro vfkzaPenaH.
GALL-STONE: pittASayaSarkarA: v. Stone.
GALL-STONE , s. pittASayajA SarkarA.

Gallant, a. SoBana, suBagadarSana; saBya, saByAcAra, suSIla; dakziRa; stryupacAraparadakza. 2 vIra, SUra, vikrAMta, mahAvIrya; See Brave. s. vallaBaH, ramaRaH, kAmukaH, kAmijanaH, kAmin m., nAyakaH, dayitaH. 2 jAraH, viwaH, upa-pattiH. 3 saByAcAraH, sujanaH; stryupacAraSIlaH-paraH. [Gallant]ry, s. dAkziRyaM; kAmacezwA, SfMgAravilasitaM, stryupAsanA, stryupacAraH. 2 vIryaM, SOryaM, DAman n., vikramaH, pOruzaM. 3 udAratA, mAhAtmyaM. [Gallant]ly, adv. savikramaM, savIryaM, SUra-vIra-vat. 2 ramaRavat.
GALLANT (adj.): I Handsome, showy: q.v.: SoBanaH (nA, naM).II Brave, courageous: q.v.; SUraH (rA, raM).III Chivalrous: dakziRa (f. RA).
GALLANT (subs.): I Lover: vallaBaH.II Para- -mour: jAraH.

GALLANT , a. (Brave, heroic) vIraH -rA -raM, pravIraH -rA -raM, mahAvIryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, SUraH -rA -raM, parAkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vikramI -miRI -mi (n), sAhasikaH -kI -kaM, mAhAtmikaH -kI -kaM, udAracetAH -tAH -taH (s). — (Courteous, inclined to courtship) saByaH -ByA ByaM, saByaSIlaH -lA -laM, suSIlaH -lA -laM, stryupAsanaSIlaH -lA -laM, stryupacAraSIlaH -lA -laM, sujanaH -nA -naM, premaSIlaH -lA -laM.

GALLANT , s. (Courtly man) saByajanaH, sujanaH. — (One attentive to ladies) stryupAsakaH, stryupacArakaH -cAraparaH. — (Lover) praRayI m. (n), kAmijanaH, kAmI m. (n), kAmukaH, nAyakaH, ramakaH. — (Paramour) jAraH, ramaRaH, upapatiH m., pApapatiH m., viwaH, cewakaH.
GALLANTLY: I Bravely: sasAhasam.II Poli- -tely:(1) dakziRam;(2) dAkziRyena.

GALLANTLY , adv. (Bravely) savIryyaM, mahAvIryyeRa, mahAvIravat, Suravat, samahASOryyaM, saparAkramaM, savikramaM, udAravat, prasaBaM. — (Like one in- -clined to courtship) stryupAsakavat, stryupacArakavat, ramaRavat.
GALLANTRY: I Courage, bravery: q.v.: SOryam.II Politeness: dAkziRyam.III Amour: praRayaH.

GALLANTRY , s. (Bravery) vIryyaM, mahAvIryyaM, SOryyaM, vIratA, SUratA, [Page300-a+ 51] pOruzaM, vikramaH, parAkramaH, DAma n. (n). — (Nobleness) udAratA, OdAryyaM, mAhAtmyaM. — (Courtliness, attention to ladies) saByatA, suSIlatA, sujanatA, stryupAsanaM, stryupacAraH.

GALLED , p. p. (Having the skin torn by friction) kzatacarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), GarzitacarmmA &c., Cinnatvak m. f. n. — (Harassed) santApitaH -tA -taM, klizwaH -zwA -zwaM, pIqitaH -tA -taM, vADitaH -tA -taM.
GALLEON: mahApotaH: v. Ship.
GALLEON , s. suvarRarUpyasantAraRe prayuktA vfhatI videSIyanOkA.
Gallery, s. maMcAH (pl.), maMcasanATaH kozWaH. 2 CannapaTaH-mArgaH. 3 aliMdaH-dakaH.

GALLERY: I A room: kozWaH, picture g.: *citra- kIzWaH.II A raised structure: maYcAH (m. pl.), R. vi. 1., ladies' g.: yozitAM maYcAH, V.p. v. 20. 26.III A covered passage: CannapaTaH and sim. comp.s.IV Underground: kulyA (= mine).

GALLERY , s. (Covered way) CannapaTaH, CannamArgaH. — (In a building) harmye or mahABavane itastato BramaRayogyaH paTaH. — (Elevated floor fur- -nished with seats) dIrGAsanayukto maYcaH or maYcakaH. — (Covered terrace outside a house) vahirdvAraprakozWakaM, varaRqaH, nizkASaH.
GALLEY: I A long boat: noH.II The cook- -room of a man-of-war: pAkasTalI.
GALLEY , s. (Long, light boat) dIrGaparimARA laGunOkA, madguH m. — (Cook-room of a ship of war) yudDanOkAyAH pAkasTAnaM.
GALLEY-SLAVE: nOdAsaH (?); potadAsaH (?).
GALLEY-SLAVE , s. Amftyor madgudaRqasaYcAraRa niyukto mahApAtakI m. (n).
GALLIARD , a. hfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, praPullaH -llA -llaM, ullasaH -sA -saM, rasikaH -kA -kaM.
GALLIC, -AN: *ParAsIyaH (yA, yaM).
GALLICISM: *ParAsIyanItiH; ParAsIyaBAzarItiH.
GALLICISM , s. PrAnsIyarItyanusArI vAgvyApAraH.
GALLIGASKINS , s. nIcaBAzAyAM sTUlavastramayaM, jaNGottarIyaM or jaNGApariDAnaM.
GALLIMATIA , s. asambadDapralApaH, anarTakavAkyaM, vfTAkaTA, pralapitaM.
GALLIMAUFRY , s. sannipAtaH, sAnnipAtikaM, prakIrRakaM, saNkIrRakaM.
Gallinaceous (fowl), s. kukkuwaH, tAmracUqaH, caraRAyuDaH.
GALLINACEOUS , a. gfhyakukkuwasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n) or -vAcakaH -kA -kaM; ‘a gallinaceous fowl,’ kukkuwaH -wI, kfkavAkuH m., tAmracUqaH, caraRAyuDaH.
GALLING (adj.): (1) kawu (mfn.) (= bitter); (2) marmAviD (mfn.).
GALLING , s. GarzaRena carmmakzatiH f., or tvakparikzatiH f., carmmadAraRaM, carmmanirGarzaRaM.
Gallinule, s. dAtyUhaH, kAlakaMWakaH.
GALLINULE: jalakukkuwaH (f. wI); jalaraNkuH, Wilson.
GALLINULE , s. kAlakaRwaH -RWakaH, nIlakaRwaH, dAtyUhaH, AtyUhaH, natyUhaH, jalaraNkuH, pItamuRqaH, maYjulaH, mAsajYaH, qAhukaH, KegamanaH, huqukkaH, mAdakaH.
GALLIPOT: GawI (?): v. Pot.
GALLIPOT , s. BepajavikretfBiH prayuktaM, mfRmayam OzaDapAtraM, calukaH, culukaH.
GALLON: dravamAnaviSezaH; ardDaprasTaH, Williams.
GALLON , s. dravadravyARAM parimARaviSezaH, ardDaprasTaH.
GALLOON , s. svarRarUpyasUtramayas tAntavAlaNkAraviSepaH.
Gallop, v. i. valg 1 P, plutagatyA cal or DAv 1 A, plu 1 A. s. plutaM, valgitaM, plavanaM.
GALLOP (v.): I Of the animal:(1) plavate (plu, c. 1.);(2) valgati (valg, c. 1.).II Of the rider: perh plutagatyA calati (cal, c. 1.); pulAyitena gacCati (gam, c. 1.).
GALLOP (subs.): (1) plutam;(2) pulAyitam;(3) valgitam. Full g: pUrRavegA gatiH, M. n.

To GALLOP , v. n. plu (c. 1. plavate, plotuM), valg (c. 1. valgati -lgituM), Avalg, Dor (c. 1. Dorati -rituM), DAv (c. 1. DAvati -vituM), pulAyitaM kf, plutagatyA or valgitena cal (c. 1. calati -lituM).
GALLOP , s. valgitaM, pulAyitaM, pulA, plutaH -taM, plavaH -vanaM, viplAvaH, vikrAntiH f., taraNgaH, DoraRaM, DoritaM -takaM, DOritakaM.
GALLOPADE , s. drutanftyaviSepo yatra narttakAH plutagatyA calanti.
GALLOPER , s. plavagaH -gatiH m., plavakaH, valgitakArI m. (n), pulAyitakft.
To GALLOW , v. a. tras in caus. (trAsayati -yituM), BI in caus. (BAyayati -yituM).

sanskrit.slp1: maDyamaparimARo na vfhan na kzudras turaNgaBedaH
sanskrit.word: मध्यमपरिमाणो न वृहन् न क्षुद्रस् तुरङ्गभेदः
sanskrit.iast: madhyamaparimāṇo na vṛhan na kṣudras turaṅgabhedaḥ

details.body: GALLOWAY , s. maDyamaparimARo na vfhan na kzudras turaNgaBedaH.
Gallows, s. vaDastaMBaH, vaDyaSilA-kAzWaM; vaDa-GAta-sTAnaM, vaDyasTalaM. ‘met his death on the g(allow)’ SUlamAropitaH.
GALLOWS: badDakAzWam (?); badDadAru (n.) (?).
GALLOWS , s. udbanDanakAzWaM, udbanDanavfkzaH, vaDasTAnaM, DAtasTAnaM.
Galoche, s. kAzWapAdukA, pAdukA.
GALOCHE , CALOSHE, s. kAzWapAdukA, uttarapAdukA, upapAdukA.
GALVANIC: *galvanIyaH (yA, yaM); gAlvanaM (nI, naM).
GALVANIC , a. vakzyamARavEdyutaSaktisambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).
GALVANISM , s. galvARinAmnA videSIyavidupA parikalpitA vidyutIyaSaktiH or vEdyutaSaktiH or AkarpakaSaktiH, vidyudvidyANgaM.
GALVANIST , s. pUrvvoktavidyudvidyASAKAtattvajYaH.
Galvanize, v. t. vidyucCaktyA Akfz 1 P or upahan 2 P.
GALVANIZE: *gAlvanIkaroti, g. d iron: *gAlvanI- kftalohaH.
To GALVANIZE , v. a. pUrvvoktavidyutIzaSaktyA Akfp (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM) or upahan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM).
GALVANIZED , p. p. pUrvvoktavEdyutaSaktyupahataH -tA -taM.

Gamble, v. i. div 4 P (akzEH akzAn vA); akzEH krIq 1 P. [Gambl]er, s. dyUtakAraH, devitf m., dyUtakft m., DUrtaH, akzadevin m., kitavaH, akzaDUrtaH. [Gambl]ing, s. dyUtaM, durodaraM, paRaH, akzavatI, akzakrIqA-dyUtaM, kEtavaM, devanaM, dyUtasevA, ‘g(ambling)-house’ dyUtaSAlA-saBA; ‘he who keeps a g(ambling)-house’ saBikaH, dyUtakArakaH.
GAMBLE: (1) dIvyati (div, c. 4.), g. s. on [Page306] hundred: Satasya dIvyati, S. k.;(2) dyutaM karoti or sevate, ni- (sev, c. 1.), M. ix. 228.
To GAMBLE , v. a. (With dice, &c.) akzEH or akzAn div (c. 4. dIvyati -te, devituM) or pradiv or pratidiv, akzEH krId (c. 1. krIqati -qituM), akzAdikrIqAM kf, dyUtakrIqAM kf, akzadyUtaM kf.
GAMBLER: (1) dyUta karaH or -kAraH;(2) devitf (m.), Mah.;(3) durodaraH (rare).
GAMBLER , s. dyatakaraH -kAraH, akzadyUtaH, akzadyUH m., akzadevI m. (n), [Page300-b+ 51] akzaDUrttaH DUrttaH, kitavaH, dyUtakrIqakaH, AkzikaH. See GAMESTER.

GAMBLING: (1) dyUtam;(2) devanam, M.;(3) durodaram (rare);(4) kEtavam (rare). G. -assembly: dyUta- saBA or dyUtasamAjam. Its president: saBikaH. G. -house: dyUtaSAlA. G. -table, g. -board: dyUtaPalakam.
GAMBLING , s. akzadyUtaM, dyUtaM, dyUtakrIqA, akzAdikrIqA, devanaM, akzavatI, dyUtasevA, kEtavaM, glahaH, paRaH, durodaraM.
GAMBOGE , s. pItavarRaH pUrvvadeSIyavfkzaniryAsaH.
Gambol, v. i. krIq 1 P, nft 4 P, itastataH, valg 1 P, plu 1 A. s. nftyaM, krIqA, lAsyaM, lIlA, keli f., KelA.
GAMBOL (subs.): nftyam (= dance); (2) krIqA (= sport).
GAMBOL (v.): (1) nftyati (nft, c. 4.) (= to dance);(2) krIqati (= to play).

To GAMBOL , v. n. (Frolic) krIq (c. 1. krIqati -qituM), vikrIq, parikrIq, div (c. 4. dIvyati -te, devituM), cittapraharzAd itastataH plu (c. 1. plavate, plotuM) or nft (c. 4. nftyati, narttituM), KelA (nom. KelAyati -yituM), kumAra (nom. kumArayati -yituM).
GAMBOL , s. krIqA -qanaM, devanaM, KelA, keliH m. f., lIlA, nftyaM, lAsyaM.
GAMBOLING , part. krIqan -qantI -qat (t), krIqamAnaH -nA -naM, dIvyan, vyatI -vyat (t).

Game, s. krIqA, KelA, keli f., lIlA, vilAsaH, pari(rI)hAsaH. 2 vanyapakzyAdi, jAMgalaH, vanyapakzin m. 3 mfgayA. 4 saMkalpaH, vyavasAyaH, kalpanA, saMdigDavyavasAyaH. v. i. krIq 1 P, div 4 P; ‘G(ame)-cock’ caraRAyuDaH, yoDakukkuwaH; ‘g(ame)-keeper’ vanyapakzipAlakaH; ‘g(ame)-leg’ paMgupAdaH. [Gam]ing, s. dyUtaM. [Game]ster, s. DUrtaH; See under Gamble. [Game]some, a. krIqA-lIlA-para, vilAsaSIla, vilAsin, parihAsaSIla, ullAsin, parihAsin, vinodin, narmAlApin.

GAME: I Sport:(1) krIqA, shewed other good g. s with a ball: krIqAntarARi darSanIyAni kandukenAda- rSayat, D.;(2) KelA, let us have a g. at chess: *caturaNgaKelAM karavAva, Ph.: you are making a g. of me: mayA saha krIqAM or KelAM karozi.II In hunting: jANgalaH, almost all g. is light and strengthening: jANgalAH prAyaSaH sarve laGavo balavarDanAH, Bha.III Project, scheme: q.v.

GAME , s. (Sport) krIqA, KelA, keliH m. f., lIlA, narmma n. (n), parIhAsaH, kUrddanaM, bilAsaH. — (Game of play) rAsaH, rAserasaH. — (Wild animals) jANgalaM, jaNgalapakzyAdi, vanyapaSvAdi, AraRyapaSupa- -kzyAdi. — (The chase) mfgavyaM, mfgayA. — (Scheme) saNkalpaH, niScitaM, vyavasitaM, vyavasAyaH, kalpanA.
To GAME , v. n. krIq (c. 1. krIqati -qituM), div (c. 4. dIvyati -te, devituM). — (With dice, &c.) akzEH krIq or div dyUtakrIqAM kf.
GAME-COCK: (1) yoDakukkuwaH;(2) caraRAyuDaH (poet), kaTamupakrAntaeva krUraDAracaraRaSastrayo ScaraRAyuDayoH kalahaH, V. t.
GAME-COCK , s. caraRAyuDaH, naKAyuDaH, yudDe SikzitaH kfkavAkuH.
GAME-EGG: yoDakukku wagarBamaRqam.
GAME-KEEPER: jANgalapAlaH (after vanapAlaH of N.).
GAME-LEG , s. KaYjajaNGA, paNgujaNGA, gativikalaH pAdaH, paNgupAdaH.
GAMEKEEPER , s. vanyapakzirakzakaH, jANgalapakzipratipAlakaH, vanyajantupozakaH.
GAMESOME: (1) krIqApriyaH (yA, yaM);(2) KelA- priyaH (yA, yaM).
GAMESOME , a. krIqAparaH -rA -raM, krIqAvAn -vatI -vat (t), lIlAvAn &c., KelAparaH -rA -raM, vilAsI -sinI -si (n), kelikaH -kA -kaM.
GAMESOMENESS , s. krIqAparatvaM, KelAparatvaM, savilAsatA, lIlAvattvaM, ullasatA.
GAMESTER: dyUtakaraH: v. Gambler.

GAMESTER , s. dyUtakaraH -kAraH, dyUtakft m., akzadevI m. (n), akzadyUtaH, akzadyUH m., akzaDUrttaH, dyUtavfttiH m., dyUtasevI m. (n), dyUtaprasaktaH, akzakrIqakaH, DUrttaH, kitavaH, akzAdisevI m., durodaraH, kfzRakohalaH.
GAMING , s. akzadyUtaM, dyUtaM -taH, dyUtakarmma n. (n), dyUtakrIqA, dyUtasevA, akzAdi- -krIqA, akzavatI, devanaM, kEtavaM, glahaH, paRaH, durodaraM.
GAMING-HOUSE , s. dyUtasaBA, dyUtasTAnaM, dyUtaSAlA, dyUtagfhaM; ‘keeper of one,’ dyUtasaBADikArI m. (n), saBikaH, dyUtADikArI m., dyUtakAraH -rakaH, dyUtavfttiH m.
Gammer, s. vfdDA strI.
Gammon, s. vallUraM, uttaptaM, sUkaraSuzkamAMsaM. 2 carmapawwa-SAri-krIqA. 3 Deceit, q. v. v. t. sUkaramAMsaM lavaRIkf 8 U. 2 Cheat, q. v.
GAMMON: I Smoked ham: DUpitavalla ram (?).II A game: v. Back-g.III An imposition: (1) Calam;(2) kapawam.
GAMMON , s. (Dried hog's flesh) vallUraM, SUkarasya SuzkamAMsaM or vAsi- -tamAMsaM. — (Game) carmmapawwikAkrIqA, SArikrIqA. — (Imposition, hoax) CalaM, vaYcanaM, kapawaH, damBaH.
To GAMMON , v. a. SUkaramAMsaM SuzkIkf or lavaRIkf, vallUraM kf. — (Hoax) pralaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), aBisanDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), vaYc (c. 10. vaYcayati -yituM).
Gamut, s. grAmaH.
GAMUT: the musical scale: grAmaH.
GAMUT , s. (Musical scale) grAmaH. The seven musical notes of the Hindū gamut are called nipAdaH, fzaBaH, gAnDAraH, paqjaH, maDyamaH, DEvataH, paYcamaH.
Gander, s. haMsaH, cakrAMgaH, cakravAkaH, cakraH; Svetagarut m., mAnasOkas m., rAjahaMsaH (white).
GANDER: haMsaH; (2) varawaH (rare).
GANDER , s. varawaH, haMsaH, rAjahaMsaH, kalahaMsaH, cakraH, cakravAkaH, cakrANgaH.
GANDHARBA , s. (A celestial musician. These are demigods who inhabit heaven, and form the orchestra at the banquets of the gods) ganDarbbaH, hAhAH (s), huhuH m., huhUH m., hahAH m.
GANDHARBA . Their chief is called citraraTaH.
Ganesh, s. gaReSaH, gaRapatiH, vinAyakaH, viGneSaH, viGnarAjaH, dvEmAturaH, gaRADipaH, eka-daMtaH, heraMbaH, laMbodaraH, gajAnanaH, gajAsyaH, gajadaMtaH.

GANESHA , s. (Son of Siva and Pārvatī, the god of wisdom, and remover of difficulties and obstacles, addressed at the commencement of all undertakings, and at the open- ing of all compositions. He is called ‘Ganesha,’ as presiding over the troop of deities attendant on Siva) gaReSaH, gaRanATaH, gaRADipaH, gaRanAyakaH, gaRapatiH m., gaRAgraRIH m. [Page301-a+ 51] gaRaH, hemANgaH, herambaH, hastimallaH, — (As remover of obstacles) viGneSaH, viGnarAjaH, viGnanASakaH -SanaH, viGnavinAyakaH, vinAyakaH, viGnahArI m. (n). — (Elephant-faced) gajAnanaH, gajavadanaH, gajAsyaH. — (Elephant-toothed) gajadantaH. — (One-toothed) ekadantaH. — (Big-bellied) lambodaraH. — (Two-bodied) dvidehaH. — (Having two mothers) dvEmAturaH.
GANESHA , s. (As having a rat for his vehicle, or attended by this animal as an emblem of sagacity) mUzikANkaH, mUzikAYcanaH, mUzikavAhanaH.
Gang, s. gaRaH, saMGaH, nivahaH; See Collection.
GANG: (1) gaRaH;(2) saNGaH: v. Crowd.
GANG , s. (Company of persons) gaRaH, janasamUhaH, janasaMsargaH, jananivahaH, saNGaH, saNgaH; ‘of thieves,’ cOragaRaH.
GANG-BOARD , s. nOkArohaRAvarohaRArTaM dIrGakAzWaPalakaM.
GANG-DAYS , s. BramaRadivasAH m. pl., parikramadivasAH, paryyawanakAlaH.
Ganges, s. gaMgA, maMdAkinI, viyadgaMgA, svarRadI, suradIrGikA, jAhnavI, jahnutanayA-kanyA, BAgIraTI, amarApagA, suranadI, trisrotas f., tripaTagA.

GANGES , s. (The River) gaNgA, gaNgAkA, gaNgikA. The name Gangā is derived from the root gam, ‘to go,’ i. e. ‘that which goes or flows on the earth,’ whence also the name BavAyanA, ‘going in the world.’ (Daughter of Jahnu. The Ganges in its course from heaven disturbed the de- votions of this saint, upon which he drank up its waters, but released them again at the intercession of the sage Bhagīratha. Hence the following names) jAhnavI, jahnutanayA, jahnusutA, BAgIraTI (Crest of Siva. The Ganges, in its descent from heaven, alighted on the head of Siva, where it wandered for a time in the tresses of his hair) haraSeKarA. (River of heaven) svarRadI, suranadI, suranimnagA, svarApagA, svargagaNgA, svarvApI, KApagA, sidDApagA. — (Flowing in heaven, earth, and hell) tripaTagA, trisrotAH f. (s). — (Flowing from the foot of Viṣṇu) vizRupadI. — (Mother of Bhīṣma) BIzmasUH f. — (The very auspicious one) mahABadrA.
GANGES , s. (As mother of Kārtikeya) kumArasUH. ‘The Ganges of heaven,’ svargaNgA, AkASagaNgA; ‘of the infernal regions,’ BogavatI.
Ganglion, s. SirAsPowaH.
GANGLION , s. snAyusPowaH -wakaH, SirAsPowakaH, nAqIvisPowaH.

sanskrit.iast: śarīrasya parabhāge svasthe sati ekabhāgasya pūtībhāvaḥ

details.body: Gangrene, s. pUtimAMsaM; mAMsapAkaH; koTaH. v. i. koTIBU 1 P, pUtIBU.
GANGRENE (subs.): expr. by galitaH (tA, taM), vi-.
GANGRENE (v.): (1) galati (gal, c. 1.);(2) galitaH (tA, taM) Bavati.
GANGRENE , s. koTaH, pUtimAMsaM, vidraDiH m., kzataM, nAlIvraRaH, mAMsapAkaH, raktavidraDiH m., mAMsapUtiH, SarIrasya paraBAge svasTe sati ekaBAgasya pUtIBAvaH.
To GANGRENE , v. n. mAMsEkadeSe pUtIBU, pUtamAMsIBU, koTIBU.
GANGRENOUS: galitaH (tA, taM), vi-.
GANGRENOUS , a. koTavAn -vatI -vat (t), koTIyaH -yA -yaM, pUtimAMsavAn &c.
Gangway, s. ArohAvarohapaTaH.
GANGWAY: I A way: dvAram.II Of a ship: maDyam.
GANGWAY , s. nOkAyAM gamanAgamanapaTaH or ArohaRAvarohaRapaTaH.
GANTLET , GANTLOPE, s. senAyAM daRqArhasya daRqaviSezaH; ‘to run the gantlet,’ mahApAtakivat sEnyAnAM yazwipARInAM dvipaMktimaDye DAv (c. 1. DAvati -te -vituM) yAvad ekEkena yazwyAGAtaH kriyate.
GAOL , s. kArA, kArAgAraM, kArAveSma n. (n), banDanAgAraM, banDanAlayaH, banDanaguhaM, banDanasTAnaM, guptiH f.
To GAOL , v. a. kArAyAM banD (c. 9. baGnAti, banDuM) or niruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM).
GAOL , s. for banDanaguhaM, read banDanagfhaM.
GAOL-DELIVERY , s. kArASudDiH f., kArAgAraSoDanaM, banDanAgAraviSoDanaM.
GAOLER , s. kArAgArADyakzaH, kArArakzakaH, banDanAlayarakzakaH.
Gap, s. CidraM, BaMgaH, vicCedaH, BedaH, raMDraM, CedaH, vivaraM, gartaH-rtA.
GAP (subs.): (1) Cidram (= hole);(2) BaNgaH (= break) (?).
GAP , s. (In a wall) sanDiH m., gfharanDraM, suruNgA, kuqyacCedaH. — (Breach, chasm) BaNgaH, BedaH, CedaH, ranDraM, CidraM, vivaraM, vicCedaH, garttaH, KaRqaH -RqanaM.
GAP-TOOTHED , a. viraladantI -ntinI -nti (n), vicCinnadantI &c.

Gape, v. i. vi-pra-jfMB 1 A; jaB-jaMB 1 A, muKaM vyAdA 3 A. 2 vi-, dal 1 P, sPuw 1 P. [Gap]ing, s. jfMBaH-BA, jfMBaRaM, jfMBikA, jfMBitaM, harman n., hAPikA, muKavyAdAnaM. a. jfMBin, jfMBita, vyAttamuKa.

GAPE (v.): I Lit.:(1) jfmBate, vi-, pra-, aBi-, upa-, (jfmB, c. 1.);(2) jamBate (jamB, c. 1.). Ph.: of the g. ing lion: jfmBAvidAritamuKasya hareH, Mu. l.; “with g. ing amazement”: vismayasti- mitaH (tA, taM).II To open as ground: vidIryate (pass. of dF), Ki.

To GAPE , v. n. jfmB (c. 1. jfmBate -mBituM), vijfmB, prajfmB, jaB or jamB (c. 1. jaBate, jamBate -mBituM), muKaM vyAdA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM) or vistF in caus. (-stArayati -yituM), jfmBaM kf, glE (c. 1. glAyati, glAtuM). — (Open in fissures) sPuw (c. 6. sPuwati -wituM), vidal (c. 1. -dalati -lituM), vidF in pass. (-dIryyate).
GAPER: (1) jfmBakaH;(2) jfmBAkArin (m.);(3) jfmBanakft (m.).
GAPER , s. jfmBI m. (n), jfmBakaH, jfmBaRakArI m. (n), muKavyAdAnakArI.
GAPING (subs.): (1) jfmBA;(2) jfmBaRam, vi-;(3) jfmBitam, vi-.
GAPING , GAPE, s. jfmBaH -mBA -mBaRaM -mBikA, jfmBitaM, vijfmBitaM, vijfmBaRaM, harmma n. (n), hAPikA, upapuzpikA. — (Opening the mouth) [Page301-b+ 51] muKavyAdAnaM, muKavivftiH f.
GAPING , part. jfmBaH -mBA -mBaM, jfmBamARaH -RA -RaM, jfmBI -mBiRI -mBi (n), jfmBAvAn -vatI -vat (t), jfmBitaH -tA -taM, vijfmBitaH -tA -taM, vyAttamuKaH -KA -KaM, vivftamuKaH -KA -KaM.
Garb, s. veSaH-zaH, vastraM, vasanaM, vAsas n., pariDAnaM, prasADanaM; ‘putting on the g(arb) of virtue’ DarmakaMcukapraveSinaH (S. 5).
GARB: vezaH: v. Dress.
GARB , s. veSaH, vezaH, vAsaH n. (s), pariDAnaM, paricCadaH, ambaraM, vastraM, vasanaM, AcCAdanaM, sajjA, prasADanaM.
Garbage, s. ucCizwaM, malaM.
GARBAGE: ucCizwam: v. Refuse.
GARBAGE , s. ucCizwaM, ucCizwAnnaM, SepAnnaM, paSor antrAdi, malaM.
Garble, v. t. sAcIkf 8 U; satyaM guh 1 U, vikf, vakrIkf.
GARBLE: KaRqIkaroti: v. To corrupt, falsify.

To GARBLE , v. a. (Pick out the best parts of a book to serve a purpose) CalArTaM or vaYcanArTaM granyasya uttamavacanAni or uttamadeSAn udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM) or samudDf or granTacUrRiM kf, granTaM KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM). — (Pervert) sAcIkf, vakrIkf, vikf, vikalIkf.

Genuine, a. akftaka, akftrima, akalpita, nirvyAja, nirvyalIka, akapawa, nizkapawa, avitaTa, satya, yaTArTa. [Genuine]ly, adv. satyaM, nizkapawaM, nirvyAjaM. [Genuine]ness, s. satyatA, yaTArTatA, nirvyAjatvaM, akftrimatA.
GENUINE: (1) akftrimaH (mA, maM) (= not arti- -ficial), g. love: akftrimaprema, Ki.;(2) nizkapawaH (wA, waM) (= without deception);(3) satyaH (tyA, tyaM) (= real: q.v.).

GENUINE , a. satyaH -tyA -tyaM, prakftaH -tA -taM, vAstavaH -vI -vaM -vikaH -kI -kaM, akalpitaH -tA -taM, akftrimaH -mA -maM, akapawaH -wA -waM, nizkapawaH -wA -waM, nirvyAjaH -jA -jaM, nirvyalIkaH -kA -kaM, yaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, sAraH -rA -raM.
GENUINELY: (1) akftrimam;(2) nizkapawam;(3) (3) satyam: v. Genuine.
GENUINELY , adv. satyaM, nizkapawaM, kapawaM vinA, nirvyAjaM, nirvyalIkaM, yaTArTaM.
GENUINENESS: (1) akftrimatA;(2) nizkapawatA; satyatA.
GENUINENESS , s. satyatA, prakftatvaM, akftrimatA, akalpitatvaM, yATArTyaM, yaTArTatA, nirvyalIkatA, nirvyAjatvaM, vAstavikatA, sAratA.
Genus, s. jAti f., gaRaH, vargaH.
GENUS: jAtiH, ‘samAnaprasavAtmikA jAtiH’, N. d.
GENUS , s. (In logic) paraM. — (Aclass) jAtiH f., gaRaH, vargaH, jAtimAtraM, gotraM.
GEOGRAPHER: *BUmaRqalavid (mfn.); BUgolajYa (f. jYA).

GEOGRAPHER , s. BUpfzWavidyAjYaH, BUgolavidyAjYaH, BUgolaSAstrajYaH, BUpfzWaleKakaH, BUgolajYAnI m. (n), BUgolasya yat kiYcid deSasamudranagarAdi vidyate tadAkAranAmAdileKakaH, BUpfzWasya deSasamudraparvvatanadyAdivyAKyAtA m. (tf), BUpfzWavivaraRakft.
GEOGRAPHICAL: *BUmaRqalavizayakaH (kA, kaM) and sim. comp.s.
GEOGRAPHICAL , a. BUgolavizayaH -yA -yaM, BUpfzWavizayakaH -kA -kaM, BUgola- SAstravizayaH -yA -yaM, BUpfzWasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), BUgolaSAstrIyaH -yA -yaM.
GEOGRAPHICALLY , adv. BUgolaSAstrAnusAreRa, BUgolaSAstravat.
Geography, s. BUgolavidyA-SAstraM, BUpfzWavidyA. [Geograph]er, s. BUgolaSAstrajYaH, BUpfzWavidyAjYaH. [Geograph]ical, a. BUgolaSAstravizayaka.
GEOGRAPHY: BUmaRqalavivaraRam and sim, comp.s. [Page310] Outlines of g.: BUmaRqalasya saMkziptavivaraRam (after V. p.); g. of India: *BArataBUmivivaraRam.

GEOGRAPHY , s. BUpfzWavidyA, BUgolavidyA, BUpfzWavizayakaM jYAnaM, BUgolasya yat kiYcid deSasamudranagarAdi vidyate tadAkAranAmAdivyAKyA, BUpfzWasya deSasamu- draparvvatanadyAdInAM jYAnaM or vivaraRaM, BUgolaSAstraM.
GEOLOGICAL: *BUtattvavizayakaH (kA, kaM) and sim, comp.s.
GEOLOGICAL , a. pArTivAMSavizayaH -yA -yaM, pfTivIvidyAsambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), pfTivIsaMsTAnavizayakaH -kA -kaM
GEOLOGICAL , s. BUstaravidyAsambanDI -DinI &c. -vizayakaH -kA -kaM.
GEOLOGICALLY: *BUtattvavidyAnusAreRa; BUtattvAnusAreRa.
GEOLOGIST: *BUtattvavid (mfn.); BUtattvavidyAviSAradaH (dA, daM); and sim. comp.s.
GEOLOGIST , s. pArTivAMSavidyAjYaH, pfTivIvidyAjYaH, pfTivIsaMsTAnavyAKyAtA m. (tf), mfttikABAvaguRAdivivaraRakft m.
GEOLOGIST , s. BUstaravidyAjYaH, BUstaranirUpakaH, kzitiracanAvid.
Geology, s. BUtattvaM, BUgarBaSAstraM, BUtattvavidyA. [Geolog]ical, a. BUtattvavizayaka. [Geolog]ist, s. BUtattvajYaH.
GEOLOGY: *BUtattvaM or BUtattvavidyA.
GEOLOGY , s. pArTivAMSAnAM jYAnaM or vidyA, pArTivAMSavizayaM jYAnaM, pfTi- vIvidyA, pArTivAMSAnAM prAcInetihAsaH, pfTivIsaMsTAnavidyA, mfttikA- saMsTAnavidyA, mfttikABAvaguRAdivivaraRavidyA.
GEOLOGY , s. BUstaravidyA, BUstaranirUpaRavidyA, kzitiracanAvidyA, kzitira- canASAstraM, BUkavacaSAstraM.

GEOMETRAL , GEOMETRIC, GEOMETRICAL, a. kzEtraH -trI -traM, kzetraparimA- RavizayaH -yA -yaM, kzetragataH -tA -taM, kzetravidyAnusArI -riRI -ri (n), reKA- gaRitasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n); ‘geometrical proof,’ kzetragatopapattiH f.
GEOMETRICALLY: reKAgaRitAnusAreRa; etc.
GEOMETRICALLY , adv. kzetravidyAnusAreRa, reKAgaRitaSAstravat or -tas.
GEOMETRICIAN: *jyAmitijYaH, reKAgaRitapaRqitaH; and sim comp.s.
GEOMETRICIAN , s. kzetravidyAjYaH, reKAgaRitavid m., kzEtrajYaH, reKAgaRita- SAstradarSI m. (n), kzetrapariprARavidyAvAn m. (t).
Geometry, s. jyAmiti f., reKAgaRanA-gaRitaM, BUmitiH. [Geometr]ic, [Geometr]ical, a. (s.) in comp.; ‘g(eometric) proof’ reKAgaRitena upapattiH. [Geometr]ician, s. BUmitijYaH.
GEOMETRY: (1) jyAmitiH, plane, solid g. *sama-,: sTUla-jyAmitiH;(2) reKAgaRitam; plane g.: *sama- BUreKAgaRitam. K. d. has kzetratattvam, but it means mensuration.
GEOMETRY , s. kzEtraM, kzetraM, kzetravidyA, kzetraparimARavidyA, kzetraparimARavizayA vidyA, reKAgaRitaM, reKAgaRitaSAstraM, reKAgaRanAvidyA; ‘proof by geometry,’ kzetragatopapattiH f.
GEOMETRY , s. kzetramitiH f., kzetratattvavidyA, BUmitividyA.
Georgic, s. kfzi-kAvyaM-gItaM.
GEORGIC: the G. s of Virgil: *vIrakIlasya kfzikAvyam.
GEORGIC , s. gomezAdivizayaM gItaM, kfzividyAvizayakaM kAvyaM.
GERANIUM , s. vakamuKAkAravIjakozaH supuzpavAn ozaDiBedaH.
GERFALCON , s. SyenaBedaH, kapotAriH m., GAtipakzI m. (n).

Germ, s. aMkuraH, aBinavodBid m. 2 bIjaM, mUlaM, yoni f., AdiH, praBavaH, bIjakAraRaM. Germinate, v. i. udBid pass., praruh 1 P, sPuw 6 P, vikas 1 P. [Germinat]ing, a. udBida-d-jja, aMkurita. [Germinat]ion, s. udBedaH, sPuwanaM.
GERM: aNkuraH (or aNkUraH) (lit. and fig.), generation of g.s in seeds: vIje'Nkurajananam, D.s; the journey of (his) sister to deceive them is the g.: aNkuraH svasuryAtrA tO parivaYcitum, Vi. vi. 1.

GERM , GERMEN, GERMIN, s. (The embryo of fruit, a bud) pallavaH -vaM, aNkuraH, aBinavodBid m., jAlakaM, kzArakaH, jozikA, kundukaM; ‘of leaves,’ mAQiH f. — (Origin, that from which any thing springs) vIjaM, yoniH m. f., AdiH m., AramBaH, garBaH, mUlaM.
GERMAN: I Kindred: sanABi (mfn.). Cousin g.: ekapitAmahaH (hA, haM).II Belonging to G. y: *SArmaRaH (RI, RaM).III G. language: *SArmaRaBAzA. Ph.: G. silver: *uparUpyam.

GERMAN , a. (Related) sambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), samparkI -rkiRI -rki (n); ‘cousin german,’ pitfvyaputraH -trI, mAtulaputraH -trI. — (Belonging to Germany) jarmmaRideSasambanDI &c., jarmmaRideSajaH -jA -jaM; ‘language,’ jarmmaRideSaBAzA.
GERMANDER , s. anekOzaDInAM sAmAnyanAma n. (n), ozaDigaRasaMjYA.
Germane, a. sanABi, saMparkin, saMpfkta.
GERMANE: I Allied: q.v.II Relevant: q.v.: expr. by samparkaH.
GERMANISM , s. jarmmaRideSaBAzAsambanDI sampradAyaH.

To GERMINATE , v. n. sPuw (c. 6. sPuwati -wituM), Pull (c. 1. Pullati -llituM), aNkura (nom. aNkurayati -yituM), vikas (c. 1. -kasati -situM), udBid in pass. (-Bidyate), prodBid, praruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM), vfD (c. 1. varDate -rDituM).
GERMINATING , part. udBijjaH -jjA -jjaM, udBid m. f. n., udBidaH -dA -daM, prarohI -hiRI -hi (n), aNkuritaH -tA -taM, PullavAn -vatI -vat, prasPuwaH -wA -waM, sPuwan -wantI -wat (t).
GERMINATION: (1) aNkurodgamaH;(2) aNkurodBedaH; etc.
GERMINATION , s. sPuwanaM, sPuwatA, udBedaH, prodBedaH, prarohaH, udvarttanaM.
GERUND: *vAhakakriyA.
GERUND , s. lAwInaBAzAvyAkaraRe kriyAvAcakaH SabdaH.
Gestation, s. garBa-DAraRaM-vahanaM-pozaRaM; garBi-RIBAvaH.
GESTATION: garBaDAraRam: v. Pregnancy.
GESTATION , s. garBaDAraRaM, garBapozaRaM, garBavahanaM, garBiRIBAvaH.

Gesticulate, v. i. aMgAni vikzip 6 P or saMcal c. v. t. aBi-nI 1 P, ni-, rUp 10, sUc 10, naw 10; See Act. [Gesticulat]ion, s. aBinayaH; aMgavikzepaH, cezwA, sUcanA, aMga-hAraH, hAvaH, saMketasUcanaM. [Gesticulat]or, s. aMga-vikzepakaH.
GESTICULATE: aNgaBaNgiM karoti.

To GESTICULATE , v. n. aNgAni vikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), hastAdi vikzip or saYcal in caus. (-cAlayati -yituM), aNgavikzepaM kf, iNg (c. 1. iNgati -NgituM), naw (c. 10. nAwayati -yituM), aBinayaM kf, ANgikakarmma kf.
GESTICULATION: aNgaBaNgiH.
GESTICULATION , s. aNgavikzepaH -paRaM, hastAdivikzepaH, aNgahAraH, iNgitaM, iNgitakaraRaM, aNgasaYcAlanaM, hastAdisaYcAlanaM, saNketakaraRaM, SARI, sUcA -canA, BAvakaraRaM, ANgikakarmma n. (n).
GESTICULATOR , s. aNgavikzepakaH, hastAdivikzepakaH, aNgasaYcAlakaH, iNgita- kArI m. (n), saNketakArI m. (n).
Gesture, s. cezwA, vyApAraH, iMgitaM, BAvaH, aBinayaH, vilAsaH, viBramaH, aMgavikzepaH, hAvaH; hastAdicAlanaM.
GESTURE: cezwA, M.; iNgitam (= sign).
GESTURE , s. iNgitaM, aNgavikzepaH, hastAdivikzepaH, saNketaH, aNgahAraH -riH m., cezwA, BAvaH, iNgaH, aBinayaH, aBinItiH f., sUcanA.
To GESTURE , v. a. sANgavikzepaM kf, sahastabikzepaM kf, sABinayaM kf.

Get, v. t. laB 1 A, Ap 5 P, arj 1 P or c., A-samA-sad c., vid 6 U, prati-A-pad 4 A, aS 5 A, aDigam 1 P, grah 9 U, A-dA 3 A. 2 (To be produced) jan 4 A, utpad 4 A, saM-ud-BU 1 P, pra-sU 2, 4 A, (with genitive of person); ‘I have got a pain in my teeth’ daMtapIqA me utpannA-jAtA. 3 Df 1 P, 10, Bf 3 U; DA 3 U; ‘I have got that book with me’ tatpustakaM matsakASe vartate; See Bear also. 4 (Cause) ex. by causal; ‘g(et) it done by him’, taM tatkAraya; oft. by anunI 1 P, protsah c., pravft c.; ‘g(et) ahead’ agresarIBU; ‘g(et) clear of’ muc pass.; ‘g(et) rid of’ AtmAnaM muc c., (with abl.) by nir in comp.; ‘g(et) abroad’ prasf-prasfp 1 P, bahulIBU 1 P; See under Abroad. [Get] among, maDye praviS 6 P or gam. [Get] at, prAp, Agam, A-yA 2 P, upasTA 1 U. [Get] away, apasf 1 P, apa-i 2 P, apakram 1 U, 4 P; cal 1 P, apa-yA gam; ‘g(et) away, you fool’ apehi re mUrKa. [Get] back, pratilaB, pratyA-dA, &c. [Get] beyond, tF 1 P, ati-i, atikram. [Get] down, avatF, avaruh 1 P, aDo gam, ni-ava-pat 1 P; (v. t.) avatF c., avaruh c., &c. [Get] in, praviS 6 P. [Get] into, pat; saMkawe patitaH ‘got into troubles’; Aruh 1 P (a car &c.); ‘he got into debt’ fRagrasto baBUva; ‘g(ett)ing into deep mud’ paMkapUramAsAdya. [Get] off, (v. i.) niHsf, nirgam, apa-yA, apa-kram, nistF. 2 avatF, avaruh; (v. t.) niras 4 U, apa-nI 1 P. [Get] on, pravft 1 A, pracal, pra-sf; ‘they long got on well’ ciraM te suKena avartaMta or kAlaM ninyuH. [Get] out, nirgam, apa-i, niHsf. 2 tyaj 1 P, muc 6 P; ‘g(et) out of bed now’ aDunA muMca SayyAM. [Get] over, [Get] through, saMtF; pAraM-aMtaM-gam, atikram, nistF, tIr 10; Aruh. 2 samAp c.; See Complete. [Get] together, saMci 5 U; samA-nI, saMgrah; See Collect. [Get] up, ut-sTA; prabuD 4 A, SayanaM tyaj 1 P or muc; (v. t.) sajjIkf 8 U, virac 10; upakxp c. [Get] upon, aDi-A-ruh. [Get]ter, s. prApakaH, labDf m., arjakaH. [Get]ting, s. lABaH, avApti f., arjanaM, aDigamaH-manaM, AgamaH, AsAdanaM.

GET (v.t.): I To obtain:(1) laBate (laB, c. 1.), man g. s what he is to g.: prAptavyamarTaM laBate manuzyaH, P. ii. 4.; to g. sleep: nidrAM laBate, A.r.; divid- ing (we) g. 72.: BaktA labDam 72, Li.; or he might g. three fortnights: laBotAsO tripakzaM vA, Kat.;(2) Apnoti, ava-, pra-, sampra-, samava-, (Ap, c. 5.), got a son by Kusha: kAkusTAt putramApa, R.; to g. one's wishes: kAmAnprApnoti, Mat.;(3) A-sAdayati, samA-, (c. of sad), where did you g. this ring: kutra tvayEtadaNgurIyakaM samAsAditam, Sa.;(4) prapadyate, ami-, samaBi-, (pad, c. 4.), one who wishes to g. beati- tude: muktiM prapitsuH, Ki.;(5) aDigacCati (gam, c. 1.), to g. a saviour: trAtAram aDigacCati, A.r.II To come into possession of:(1) jAyate, saM-, (jan, c. 4.) (with gen. of the person g. ting), I have got headache with this exercise: vyAyAmena mamA'nena jAtA Sirasi vedanA, Mah. iii. 29:. 3.;(2) utpadyate, sam-, (pad, c. 4.) (same cons.), Ra.III To induce: expr. by causal v., to g. food cooked: BaktAni pAcayati, Mah.; to g. work done: karma kArayati, M.

GET (v.i.): I To become: q.v.: to g. angry: kopaM gacCati; to g. disunited: viSlezam eti, Ki.; to g. red: lohitAyate (nomi.), to g. cloudy: durdinAyate; to g. clear: sudinAyate, S.k.II To arrive: q.v.: prApnoti (with acc.), got to the town: nagaraM prApuH, K.s.

To GET , v. a. (Obtain) Ap (c. 5. Aptoti, AptuM), prAz, azAp, [Page306-a+ 51] samprAp, samavAp; laB (c. 1. laBate, labDuM), upalaB, arj (c. 1. arjati rjituM, c. 10. arjayati -yituM), upArj, Asad (c. 10. -sAdayati -yituM), samAsad, aDigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), gam, pratipad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), Apad, aBipad, AviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM). i (c. 2. eti -tuM), aS (c. 5. aSnute, aSituM), upAS, samaS. — (Have) DA (c. 3. daDAti, Datte, DAtuM), Df in caus. (DArayati -yituM), Bf (c. 3. biBartti, BarttuM), Ap. — (Beget) jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM). — (Learn) Sikz (c. 1. Sikzate -kzituM), aDI (c. 2. aDIte, aDyetuM rt. i), aDigam. — (Induce, persuade) anunI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), protsah (c. 10. -sAhayati -yituM), or expressed by the causal; as, ‘he got him to return,’ nivarttayAmAsa. — (Earn) upArj, laB. — (Receive, take) AdA (c. 3. -datte -dAtuM), grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), upalaB. — (Procure, get ready) kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), parikxp, sajjIkf, utpad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM). — (Get together) samAnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), saYci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM), samAdA, saNgrah, ekIkf, ekatra kf. — (Get over, get through, surmount) Aruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM), aDiruh, atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), tIr (c. 10. tIrayati -yituM), pAr (c. 10. pArayati -yituM), tF (c. 1. tarati -rituM -rItuM), nistF; ‘get over a difficulty,’ duHKam Aruh, duHKapAraM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), duHKasyAntaM gam. — (Get up, prepare) upaskf, saMskf, puraskf, virac (c. 10. -racayati -yituM), sajjIkf. — (Get into debt) fRaM kf, fRagrastaH -stA -staM BU, fRavAn -vatI -vad BU.

To GET , v. n. (Arrive at) Agam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), upagam, aBigam, prAp (c. 5. -Aptoti -AptuM), avAp, AyA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM), upasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM). — (Get away) apagam, apayA, ape (c. 2. apEti -tuM, rt. i), apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), apakram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), cal, (c. 1. calati -lituM), prasTA. — (Get before) agre or pUrvve or pUrvvam Agam or prAp. — (Get clear) muc in pass. (mucyate). — (Get down) avaruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM), avatF (c. 1. -tarati -rituM -rItuM), aDo yA or gam. — (Get in) viS (c. 6. viSati, vezwuM), praviS, niviS, AviS. — (Get off, escape) palAy (c. 1. palAyate -yituM, rt. i), vipalAy, nistF, apakram, nirgam. — (Get off, alight) avatF, avaruh. — (Get out) apagam, apasf, ape. — (Get up) utTA for utsTA. — (Get quit of) muc in pass. — (Get on) pragam, pravft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), prasf, prayA, pracal. — (Get drunk) mattaH -ttA -ttaM BU, unmattIBU; ‘get out with you,’ apasara, apEhi, apehi.

GET ABROAD: (1) prasarati (sf, c. 1.), D. iii.; (2) prasarpati (sfp, c. 1.), the rumour got abroad on all sides: pratidiSaM lokavAdaH prAsarpat, D. viii.; (3) bahulImavati (BU, c. 1.), Sa. vi.;(4) praTate (praT, c. 1.) (= to be known), the fame of Dhanamitra got abroad: Danamitrasya kIrtirapraTata, D. ii.
GET ACROSS: pAraM gacCati (to go) or nayati (to take).
GET AHEAD: agre Bavati or agrasahIBavati (with gen.): v. Also to advance.
GET ALONG: v. To proceed. G. a.!: antara- mantaram, Mr.
GET AMONG: maDye Bavati, g. ing among them un- perceived: tatrEva janAnulInaH, D. iv.
GET AT: prApnoti (Ap, c. 5.) (with acc.): v. To reach.
GET AWAY: apasarati (sf, c. 1.): v. To go away, escape.
GET BACK: I Intrans.: punaH prApnoti, Ku.: v. To return.II Trans.:(1) punarlaMBate, Ki.; (2) by sim. get: q.v.: he got back youth: yOvanaM pratipede saH, Mat.
GET BEYOND: atikrAmyati (kram, c. 4.): v. To go beyond.
GET CLEAR OF: (1) nirmocayati (muca, c. 10.) v. To release;(2) unmajjati (masj, c. 1.): v. To emerge.
GET DOWN: I Intrans:(1) avatarati (tF, c. 1.);(2) avarohati (ruh, c. 1.).II Trans.: (1) avatArayati (c. of tF), V. i.;(2) avarohayati (c. of ruh), R. i. 54.
GET HOLD OF: prApnoti (= to get: q.v.): v. Also to seize.
GET IN (v.): I To enter: q.v.: praviSati (viS, c. 6.): v. Also to get into.II To collect: q.v.: samAharati (hf, c. 1.).

GET INTO: Ph.: to g. into a carriage: pravahaRam Arohati or aDirohati (ruh, c. 1.), Mr. or aDyAste (As, c. 1.), R. vi. 10.; he himself helped Damayantī in g.ting into the car: raTe sa BEmIM svayamaDyarUruhat, N. xvi. 114.; to g. into debt: fRa- grastaH (stA, staM) Bavati.
GET OFF: I Trans.: v. To extricate.II Intrans: (a) to escape: q.v.: apasarati; (b) to be acquitted: perh. niHsarati; muktaH (ktA, ktaM) Bavati.II To alight: q.v.
GET ON: expr. by vartate (vft, c. 1.).
GET OUT: I To go out: apEti (i, c. 2.).II To leave: muYcati (muc. c. 6.), tyajati (tyaj, c. 1.), etc., g. o. of bed: SayyAM muYca, R.; g. ting out of temper: vihAya DEryam, B. xii. 76.
GET READY: sajjIkaroti, -kurute: v. To prepare.
GET RID OF: (1) AtmAnaM mocayati (muc, c. 10.) (with abl.) (to disengage oneself);(2) dUrIkaroti (= to remove.)
GET THE BETTER OF: (1) pariBavatiH v. To over- -come;(2) Avarjayati.: v. To bend.
GET THROUGH: I To complete: q.v.: samApayati (c. of Ap).II To traverse, arrive: q.v.
GET TOGETHER: samAharatiH v. To assemble, bring together.

GIRAFFE: *dIrDagrIvaH; citrozwraH.
GIRAFFE , s. tarakzurUpeRa citrita uzwrajAtIyo dIrGagrIvo jantuBedaH.

Gird, v. t. pari-aDi-vezw c., pari-vf 5 U or c. 2 A-baMD 9 P, pari-DA 3 U, saM-pi-nah 4 P; ‘g(ird) round the body’ SarIraM prAvf or AcCad 10, pari-baMD or pari-DA; ‘g(ird) up oneʼs loins’ parikaraM baMD; ‘girt by the (golden) lightning, as by a yellow garb’ vidyutpraBAracitapItapawottarIyaH (Mr. 5). s. See Cramp. [Gird]ed, Girt, a. badDa, AnadDa, parivezwita, parivfta; valaya-meKalA-rasanA in comp.; ‘sea-g(irded) earth’ samudra-rasanA-udaDivalayA-pfTvI.

GIRD (v.t.): (1) vezwayati, ADi- (vezw, c. 10.) (= to encircle: q.v.), g. ed by the mountain...... BUmiBftADivezwitaH (tA, taM), Ki. xii. 22.;(2) nahyati, api-, (nah, c. 4.) (= to fasten), the matted hair g. ed upon with snakes: BujaNgamonnadDa- jawAkalApaH (pA, paM), Ku. iii. 46.

To GIRD , v. a. (Bind round) banD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM), paribanD. — (Bind on) AbanD, pinah (c. 4. -nahyati -nadDuM), avanah, sannah, pinadDaM -dDAM -dDaM kf, Akac (c. 1. -kacate -cituM); ‘gird the loins,’ kawiM banD. — (Encircle, invest) parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -zwituM, c. 10. -vezwayati -yituM), pariDA (c. 3. -daDAti -Datte -DAtuM), parivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM).
To GIRD , v. n. (Gibe) kzip (c. 6. kzipati, kzeptuM), avakzip, avahas (c. 1. -hasati -situM).
GIRD , s. AkarzaH, SUlaM, apatAnakaH, apatantrakaH, AkzepakaH, vetrAGAtaH.
GIRDED , p. p. badDaH -dDA -dDaM, pinadDaH -dDA -dDaM, AnadDaH -dDA -dDaM, avanadDaH -dDA -dDaM, AbadDaH -dDA -dDaM, parivezwitaH -tA -taM, parihitaH -tA -taM.
GIRDER: ADAradAru (n.) (?).
GIRDER , s. gfhatale vfhatkAzWaM or agrakAzWaM or mahAdAruH m.

Girdle, s. meKalA, raSa(sa)nA, kAMci-cI f., saptakI, sArasanaM (of women); kawisUtraM, kawivalayaM, kakzyA-kzA, parikaraH, kawibaMDanI, SfMKalaH-lA-laM (of men). 2 vezwanaM, pari-A-vezwanaM, maMqalaM, valayaH-yaM, cakravAlaM. 3 rASicakraM. v. t. pari-vezw c., pari-vf 5 U, meKalayA baMD 9 P; See Gird.
GIRDLE: (1) meKalA;(2) rasa(Sa)nA;(3) kAYcI;(4) kakzyA;(5) sArasanam;(6) parikaraH (any g.), with tied g.: vadDaparikaraH, D.;(7) SfNalI (= man's g.).

GIRDLE , s. (Belt) meKalA, rasanA, kawisUtraM, kawibanDanaM -nI, kAYcI, kalApaH, kakzA, kakzyA, parikaraH, sArasaM -sanaM, vasnanaM, saptakI, SakkarI, raSanA, SfNKalA. — (Inclosure, circumference) vezwanaM, parivezwanaM, AvezwanaM, maRqalaM, valayaH, cakravAlaM. — (Zodiac) rASicakraM.
To GIRDLE , v. a. meKalayA banD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM), vezw (c. 1. vezwate -zwituM, c. 10. vezwayati -yituM), parivezw, parivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM).
GIRDLER , s. meKalAkAraH, rasanAkarttA m. (rttf), kawisUtrakArI m. (n).

Girl, s. kanyA, bAlA, bAlikA, kumArI, dArikA, vAsUH; See Daughter also; ‘one born from a g(irl)’ kAnInaH, kanyakAjAtaH. [Girl]hood, s. bAlaBAvaH, bAlyaM, kumArItvaM. [Girl]ish, s. kanyAnurUpa, bAleya.
GIRL: (1) bAlA;(2) bAlikA;(3) kanyA (= un- -married g. and gen. with ref. to the parents);(4) kfmArI (= a virgin);(5) vAsU (only in addressing g.s.).
GIRL , s. kanyA, kumArI, taruRI, bAlA, bAlikA, putrI, dArikA, anAga- tArttavA, lagnikA, nagnikA, gOrI, vAsUH f.
GIRLHOOD: (1) bAlyam (= childhood: q.v.); (2) bAlikAvasTA;(3) bAlaBAvaH, K.
GIRLHOOD , s. kanyAtvaM, kumArItvaM, taruRItvaM, kOmAryyaM, tAruRyaM.
GIRLISH: I Pertaining to a girl: expr. by comp.II Like a girl: expr. by circumlo, g. taste: bAlAnAmiva ruciH.
GIRLISH , a. kanyAyogyaH -gyA -gyaM, kumArIyogyaH -gyA -gyaM.
GIRLISHLY: (1) bAleva;(2) kfmArIvaH v. Girl, like.
GIRLISHLY , adv. kanyAvat, kumArIvat, taruRIvat, kanyArUpeRa.
GIRT , p. p. badDaH -dDA -dDaM, pinadDaH -dDA -dDaM, vezwitaH -tA -taM, parivezwitaH -tA -taM; ‘girt with a falchion,’ badDanistriMSaH -SA -SaM; ‘sea-girt,’ samudrameKalaH -lA -laM.
Girth, s. varatrA, naDrI, vaDrI; dU(cU)zyA, kakzA-kzyA.
GIRTH: I Of a horse:(1) varatrA;(2) vardDram. II The middle: maDyam.
GIRTH , s. udaratrARaM, aDobanDanaM -nI, varatrA, vardDraM, vardDrI, nadDrI, cUzA, kakzA, kakzyA.
To GIRTH , v. a. varatrayA banD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM), udaratrARaM pinah (c. 4. -nahyati -nadDuM).
Gist, s. PalitArTaH, nizkarzaH, BAvaH, PalitaM, paramArTaH, piMqitArTaH.
GIST: (1) PalitArTaH;(2) PalArTaH.
GIST , s. arTaH, muKyArTaH, paravArTaH, uttamArTaH, agravizayaH.

Give, v. t. dA 1 P, 3 U, f c. (arpayati), pratipad c., dad 1 A, viSraR 10, ut-vi-sfj 6 P, (with dat. of person); nikzip 6 P, saMkram c. (with loc.); tyaj 1 P, diS 6 P. 2 (Produce) ex. by BU 1 P, saMpad 4 A, jan 4 A; ‘3 repeated 2 times g(ive)s 6’ dvirAvfttAstrayaH zaq BavaMti-saMpadyaMte ‘g(ive) chase’ anusf-anuDAv 1 P; ‘g(ive) ear’ avaDA 3 U, karRaM dA, Sru 5 P; ‘g(ive) ground’ apakram 1 U, 4 P; apasf, parA-ni-vft 1 A; tyaktvA gam 1 P; ‘g(ive) oneʼs self up to’ sev 1 A, Baj 1 A; AsaMj pass., Asakta-nirata-nivizwa a. BU, (with loc.); ‘g(ive) offence’ aparAD 4, 5 P, vipriyaM-pratikUlaM-kf 8 U or Acar 1 P; ‘g(ive) utterance’ udIr 10, uccar c., udAhf 1 P. [Give] away, (in marriage) pratipad c., utsfj, pra-dA. 2 viSraR, dAnena kzE c. (kzapayati). [Give] back, pratidA, prati-f c., niryat 10. [Give] forth, praT 10, prakAS c., nivid c., KyA c. (KyApayati). [Give] in, anuman 4 A, anumud 1 A; svAgrahaM tyaj. [Give] off, Abandon, q. v. [Give] out, nivid c., prakAS c., Guz 10, praT 10, praKyA c. 2 muc 6 P, visfj, udvam 1 P, ud-gF 6 P, niHsf c. [Give] over, tyaj, utsfj, nivft 1 A, viram 1 P, (with abl.). 2 asADya a. iti matvA tyaj; ASAM tyaj; (v. i.) Sam 4 P, pat 1 P; ‘when the winds g(ive) over’ SAMte pavane. [Give] up, tyaj, hA 3 P, ut-vi-sfj. 2 nivft, viram; ‘g(ive) up for lost’ nazwaprAya a. man 4 A. [Give] way, Sam 4 P, nivft, viram, SiTilIBU. 2 BaMj pass., avasad 1 P; ‘the cord gave way’ rajjurBagnA; ‘the wall gave way’ BittiravasannA. 3 ava(pa)sf, apa-i, mArgaM dA or tyaj, apakram, apa-yA. 4 vaSaM gam-i-yA aDIna-vaSa-Ayatta a. BU; ‘do not g(ive) way to grief’ Suco vaSaM mA gamaH, SokA-DIno mA BUH, vEklavyaM mAvalaMbasva. [Giv]er, s. dAtf m., tyAgin m.; gen. ex. by dAyaka, da, prada, dAyin, in comp.; ‘g(iver) of milk’ payodAyinI, dugDapradA, &c. [Giv]ing, s. dAnaM, visarjanaM, utsargaH, tyAgaH, vitaraRaM, arpaRaM, pratipAdanaM, viSrARanaM. Gift, s. dAnaM, pratipAdanaM; See above. 2 dAnaM, upahAraH, upAyanaM, upadA, prItidAnaM, prABftaM, pradeSanaM, upagrAhyaM; ‘one deserving a g(ift)’ dakziRIya, dakzi-RArha, dakziRya; ‘marriage-g(ift)’ yOtakaM, sudAyaH. 3 guRaH, Sakti f. [Gift]ed, a. upeta, saM-upa-panna, viSizwa, yukta, anvita, SAlin in comp. 2 guRopeta, guRasaMpanna, guRin, guRavat.

GIVE (v.t.): I To bestow:(1) dadAti, datte or yacCati, pra-, sampra-, saM-, (dA, c. 3. and 1), the king g.s him his daughter and lieutenancy: tasmE rAjA dadAti tanayAM ca yOvarAjyaM ca, K.s. xxiv. 53.; to g. knowledge: vidyAM dAtum, Ki. iii. 23.;(2) vitarati (tF, c. 1.) (= to g. freely), I will g. you eyes: cakzuste vitarAmyaham, Mah.;(3) vi-sarjayati, ati- (sfj, c. 10.) (= to g. lavishly), for taking is to g.: AdAnaM hi visargAya, R. iv. 86.;(4) prati- pAdayati (c. of pad) (rare) (= to make over), g. ing of things with faith: arTAnAM SradDayA pratipAdanam, H.s.;(5) sparSayati (c. of spfS) (rare) (= to cause to reach), g. ing millions of kine: gAH kowiSaH sparSayata, R. iii. 49.II To deliver: [Page313] (1) dadAti there are six ways of g. ing and taking: zaqviDo dAnAdAnaviDiH, N.s.;(2) arpayati, sam-, gave (the child) to the queen to bring up: devyE varDayeti samarpitavAn, D.III To produce: jAyate saM-, (jan, c. 4.), striking off twenty, it g.s interest: ..... viMSatyApavartya jAtaM kalAntaram, Li.IV To admit: q.v.: parigfhvAti (grah, c. 9.). V. To devote: q.v.: AtmAnaM dadAti or samarpayati, Miscel., to g. ear: karRaM dadAti, Sa. i.; to g. advice: upadeSaM dadAti, P.; to g. way (in the street, etc.): vartma dadAti, Ki. xiv. 14. or antaraM dadAti, Mr. x.; to g. order: AjYAM dadAti, V.p.; to give time: kAlaM dadAti, Mat.; to g. thanks: DanyavAdaM karoti (?),

To GIVE , v. a. dA (c. 3. dadAti, datte, dAtuM), pradA, prAdA, aBidA, sampradA, [Page308-a+ 51] nidA, anudA, sandA, yam (c. 1. yacCati -te, dAtuM), prayam, saMyam, pratiyam, samprayam, dad (c. 1. dadate -dituM), pratipad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), upapad, f in caus. (arpayati -yituM), samf, nikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), vitF (c. 1. -tarati -rituM -rItuM), viSraR (c. 10. -SrARayati -yituM), tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), visfj (c. 10. -sarjayati -yituM), grah in caus. (grAha- yati -yituM), Ahf (c. 1. harati -harttuM), upahf, saNkfm in caus. (-krAma- yati -yituM), diS (c. 6. diSati, dezwuM). — (Give away) pradA, prayam. — (Give back) pratidA, pratipad, pratyarp (caus. of f with prati), niryat (c. 10. -yAtayati -yituM), pratiniryat, pratiruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM). — (Give chase) anuDAv (c. 1. DAvati -vituM), anusf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM). — (Give forth) prakAS (c. 10. -kASayati -yituM), KyA in caus. (KyApayati -yituM), nivid (c. 10. -vedayati -yituM). — (Give the hand for support) karAlambanaM kf. — (Give in) anudA, anujYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -nIte -jYAtuM), tyaj. — (Give over) tyaj, utsfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), viram (c. 1. -ramati -rantuM) with abl. c., nivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM) with abl. c. ‘To give over a sick man,’ asATya iti pariCidya rogAturaM muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM). — (Give out) nivid, prakAS, viGuz (c. 10. -Gozayati -yituM); ‘emit,’ utsfj, muc, niHsf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM). — (Give up) tyaj, parityaj, santyaj; hA (c. 3. jahAti, hAtuM), vihA; utsfj, vimuc, uYJ (c. 6. uYJati -YJituM), proYJ, pratyAdiS. — (Give one's self up to) AsaYj in pass. (-sajyate or -sajjate), sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM), Asev, AsaktaH -ktA -ktaMBU, nirataH -tA -taM BU. — (Give ground) apakram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), avasTA (c. 1. -tizWate -syAtuM), parAvft, nivft. — (Give way) panTAnaM dA, tyaj, avasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM); ‘give way,’ avasarata, panTAnaM tyajata. — (Give in marriage) dA, pradA, upAdiS; ‘the girl is given in marriage to a husband,’ kanyA voQuH pradIyate. — (Give thanks) DanyavAdaM kf, DanyaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), kuSalaM vad. — (Give ear) karRaM dA. — (Give power) SaktiM dA, kzamatAm f, niyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yoktuM). — (Give utterance) udIr (c. 10. -Irayati -yituM), uccara (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), udAhf. — (Give suck) De in caus. (DApayati -yituM), upaDe, pA in caus. (pAyayati -yituM). — (Give offence) ruz in caus. (rozayati -yituM), vipriyaM kf.

To GIVE , v. n. (Give way, sink) sada (c. 1. sIdati, sattuM), avasad. — (Relent, be mitigated) Sam (c. 4. SAmyati, SamituM), praSam, SAntiM or sAntvanaM yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM), SAntIBU, SiTilIBU. — (Recede) apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), nivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), apayA. — (Cease) viram (c. 1. -ramati -rantuM), nivft, Sam. — (Give in to) anujYA (c. 9. -jYAnAti -jYAtuM), anuman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM).
GIVE AWAY: pradadAti v. To give (I).
GIVE BACK: (1) pratyarpayati;(2) pratidadAti: v. To return (I).
GIVE CHASE: anuDAvati (DAv, c. 1.): v. To pursue.
GIVE IN (v.t.): dadAti, pra-: v. Also to declare.
GIVE IN TO: i.e. to adopt: parigfhRAti (grah, c. 9.).
GIVE OFF: (1) tyajati, pari-, (tyaj, c. 1.);(2) jahAti, vi-, (hA, c. 3.); etc.

sanskrit.slp1: guhyaM karma ca mantraM ca na martuH samprakASayet
sanskrit.word: गुह्यं कर्म च मन्त्रं च न मर्तुः सम्प्रकाशयेत्
sanskrit.iast: guhyaṃ karma ca mantraṃ ca na martuḥ samprakāśayet

details.body: GIVE OUT: 1. To announce: Ph.: g. ing out that the queen was burnt: devI dagveti vArtAmutpAdya, Ra. iv.; should not g. out master's secret acts and counsel: guhyaM karma ca mantraM ca na martuH samprakASayet, Ka. v. 31.: v. To disclose, reveal. II To emit: q.v.III To yield: q.v.
GIVE UP: I Lit.:(1) dadAti;(2) samarpayati: v. To give (II and V).II To despair: ASAM jahAti, tyajati, etc. (with loc.).III To cease: q.v.

GIVE WAY: I To yield to force:(1) avasIdati (sad, c. 1.) (?);(2) Bajyate, (pass. of BaYj) (= to break).II Fig.: vaSaM gacCati (gam, c. 1.), you should not g. way to sorrow: Suco vaSaM gantuM nArhasi, R. viii. 90.III To comply with: anumanyate (man, c. 4.) (with acc.).
GIVEN: in math.: expr. by yadi ..... syAt.

GIVEN , p. p. dattaH -ttA -ttaM, pradattaH -ttA -ttaM, prattaH -ttA -ttaM, nIttaH -ttA -ttaM, nihitaH -tA -taM, nikziptaH -ptA -ptaM, pratipAditaH -tA -taM, upapAditaH -tA -taM, viSrARitaH -tA -taM, arpitaH -tA -taM, samarpitaH -tA -taM, vitIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, visarjjitaH -tA -taM, visfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, upanyastaH -stA -staM; ‘well given,’ sUttaH -ttA -ttaM; ‘given and taken,’ dattAdattaH -ttA -ttaM, dattApahftaH -tA -taM. — (Given up) tyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, parityaktaH -ktA -ktaM, utsfzwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Addicted to) AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, rataH -tA -taM, nirataH -tA -taM; ‘given quantity,’ dfSyaH.

GIVER (subs.): (1) dAtf, pra-, (f. trI,) a g. unasked: ayAcitapradAtA, Ga.;(2) -daH or -pradaH (dA, daM) or dAyin (f. nI) in comp., money-g.: DanadaH; g. s of fire and water: agnyudakadAyinaH, Kat.;(3) tyAgaSAlin (f. nI) (= a lavish g.), Si.
GIVER , s. dAtA m. (tf), pradAtA, dAyakaH, dAyI m. (n), dAnakarttA m. (rttf), dAkaH, dAdI m. (n), pradaH or daH in comp., tyAgI m. (n); ‘giver and receiver,’ dAtfgAhakO m. du., dAtfpratIcCakO m. du.
GIVING (subs.): (1) dAnam (best equiv.);(2) pradAnam, saM-;(3) pratipAdanam;(4) vitaraRam;(5) visarjanam(6) viSrARanam (rare): v. To give.
GIVING (adj.): (1) -daH or -pradaH (dA, daM), life-g.: prARapradaH (dA, daM); strength g: baladaH (dA, daM), Bha.; (2) -dAyin (f. nI).
GIVING , s. dAnaM, pradAnaM, sampradAnaM, tyAgaH, vitaraRaM, visarjjanaM.
GIZZARD: of birds: jaWaraH (?).
GIZZARD , s. kukkuwAdInAM jaWaraH or udaraM or antarjaWaraM or pakvASayaH.
Glacial, a. himarUpa, hEma (mI f.), hima.
GLACIAL , a. himyaH -myA -myaM, hEmaH -mI -maM, himarUpaH -pA -paM.
To GLACIATE , v. n. himIBU, himavat saMhatIBU or SItIBU.
GLACIATION , s. SItIkaraRaM, SItIBAvaH, himIkaraRaM, himasaMhatiH f.
Glacier, s. himAnI, himasaMhati f.
GLACIER: *saMhatahimakzetram; SilIBUtahiBUmiH.
GLACIER , s. himaparvvatotsaNge suvistIrRA himasaMhatiH.
Glacis, s. pravaRa-nimna-BUmi f.
GLACIS: *bahiHpravaRaH; bahiHpravaRA BUmiH.
GLACIS , s. durgavahirBAge pravaRaBUmiH f. or nimnaBUmiH or sTAnaM kramaSo'DogamyaM.

Glad, a. pra-, saM-, hfzwa, AnaMdita, prIta, sAnaMda, pramudita, tfpta, sollAsa, ullasita, prasanna. 2 harzajanaka, harza-AnaMda-kara (rI f.); naMdaka, ramaRIya, pramodin; ‘I am g(lad)’ haMta, dizwyA. [Glad]den, v. t. A-, naMd c., prI 9 P, 10; See Delight. [Glad]dening, a. harzada, prItiprada, harzakara, pramodin. [Glad]ly, adv. saharza, sAnaMdaM, sapramodaM, hfzwamanasA, saMtozeRa, prItyA, sAhlAdaM. [Glad]ness, s. harzaH, pramodaH, AhlAdaH, saMtozaH, prIti f., ullAsaH, cittaprasAdaH, tuzwi f. [Glad]some, See (a.).
GLAD (adj.): (1) hfzwaH (zwA, zwaM), pra-, saM-, (best equiv.);(2) AnanditaH (tA, taM);(3) sAnandaH (ndA, ndaM);(4) AhlAditaH (tA, taM). To become g.: hfzyati (hfz, c. 4.): v. Delighted, to be.

GLAD , a. hfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, prahfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, hfzwahfdayaH -yA -yaM, hfzwamAnasaH -sA -saM, harzayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, AnandI -ndinI -ndi (n), AnanditaH -tA -taM, sAnandaH -ndA -ndaM, prItaH -tA -taM, AhlAditaH -tA -taM, prahlAditaH -tA -taM, prahlannaH -nnA -nnaM, tuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, parituzwaH -zwA -zwaM, tfptaH -ptA -ptaM, prasAditaH -tA -taM, praPullaH -llA -llaM, ullasaH -sA -saM -sitaH -tA -taM, aBirucitaH -tA -taM, mattaH -ttA -ttaM. — (Making glad) harzakaH -kA -kaM, nandakaH -kA -kaM, modakaH -kA -kaM, AnandakaraH -rI -raM, harzakaraH -rI -raM, suBagaH -gA -gaM, ramaRIyaH -yA -yaM.

To GLAD , GLADDEN, v. a. hfz (c. 10. harzayati -yituM), prahfz, parihfz, nand (c. 10. nandayati -yituM), aBinand, hlAd (c. 10. hlAdayati -yituM), AhlAd, prahlAd, ram (c. 10. ramayati -yituM), ullas (c. 10. -lAsayati -yituM), tup (c. 10. tozayati -yituM), tfp (c. 10. tarpayati -yituM), pramud (c. 10. -modayati -yituM), prI (c. 9. prIRAti, c. 10. prIRayati -yituM).
GLADDEN: harzayati, pra-, saM-, (c. of hfz): v. To delight, please.
GLADDENED , p. p. AhlAditaH -tA -taM, AnanditaH -tA -taM, pramoditaH -tA -taM.
GLADDENING , a. harzakaH -kA -kaM, harzaRaH -RA -RaM, harzakaraH -rI -raM, nandakaH -kA -kaM, AnandanaH -nA -naM, AnandadaH -dA -daM, prItidaH -dA -daM.

GO: I In gen.:(1) gacCati (gam, c. 1.), when Keyūraka had gone: gate ca keyUrake, K.; true and going to (i.e. reaching) the heart: yaTArTA hfdayaNgamA, Ku.; the danger is gone: gataM Bayam,V i. 5.; is gone, will not return: gata eva na nivartate, Ku. iv. 30.; a road going to the Golden City: suvarRapuragABI panTAH, K.; that they should go the way of their husbands: yadBarturgatirgantavyeti, P. iv.; in her absence, (it) goes to the daughter: tadaBAve duhitfgAmi, V s.;(2) yAti (yA, c. 2.), and you go to another (man): aparaYca yAsi, Mr. iv.; the man will go one month: mAsamekaM naro yAti, H.; moon- light goes (away) with the moon: SaSinA saha yAti kOmudI, Ku.;(3) eti (i, c. 2.), come, come, let us go: ehye hi vAmaH; U.;(4) vrajati (vraj, c. 1.), go and conquer the enemies: Braja jaya ripulokam, Ki.II To sell: expr. by laBate (lam, c. 1.) or prApnoti (Ap, c. 5.), eight go for hundred: azwO laBante Satam, Li.III To fare, turn out: q.v. Ph.: go in: aByantaraM praviSa, Mr. i.; he has gone too far: atiBUmimayaM gataH, K.; he is going (lit. wishes) to say something: kimapyayaM vivakzuH, Ku.; or vaktukAmaH, Sa.; (I am) going to ask something: kiYcit prazwumanAH, Ku.; as the story goes: kila (enclitic); to go for nothing: viPalIBavati.

‘g(ood) for nothing’ nirupayoga, nirguRa, nizPala; ‘as g(ood) as’ samaM. s. upakAraH, upakfti f. 2 hitaM, BUti f., BadraM, SuBaM, kalyARaM, kuSalaM, Sreyas n., kzemaM; oft. by arTa; ‘for the g(ood) of the people’ prajArTaM, lokahitAya, prajABUtaye, &c. 3 upa-yogaH, lABaH, PalaM; GOOD: I In ordinary sense:(1) uttamaH (mA, maM), the g. things of Camphor island: karpUradvipasyotta- mAni vastUni, H. iv.; his best painter: nijaScitra- karottamaH, K.s. 57. 123.; the best of men (God): puruzottamaH,(2) utkfzwaH (zwA, zwaM) (= excellent), g., bad, and middling: utkfzwApakfzwamavyamaH, K. b.; (3) viSizwaH (zwA, zwaM) (= very g.), very g. cloth: viSizwavastram, P. iii. 9.;(4) su or sat prefixed: a g. poet: sukaviH, Bha.; a. g. physician: suciki- tsakaH; a g. judge: sadvicArakaH; g. man: sajjanaH or sim. sat, U.; of g. appearance: surUpaH (pA, paM); (5) guRavat (f. tI) (having g. qualities), g. soil: guRavatI BUmiH, Ka.; g. wife: guRavatI BAryA; (6) darSanIyaH (yA, yaM) or dfSya (f. SyA) (g. to see), other g. games: krIqAntarARi darSanOyAni, D.II Suited, adopted: hitaH (tA, taM), g. for cattle: gohitaH (tA, taM), Ka. iv. 51.; sour gruel is not g. in fever: yavAgUrna hitA jvare, Bha.III Proper: right: q.v.: SstaH (stA, staM), N. iii. 9.IV Considerable: su-, for a g: while: suciram, K.; g. many days: subahUndivasAn, C. viii.; a g. number of: subahu (mfn.).V Auspicious: q.v.: SuBaH (BA, BaM). Ph.: g. fellow: BadraH or BadramuKaH; g.-for- nothing: akarmaRya (f. RyA) or sometimes by a- in comp., a field g.-for-nothing: akzetram, M.; a. g. deal: (adv.): viSezeRa; be so g. as, be g. enough: anugrahapurvakam; this is a g. day to me: ayaM me sudivasaH, U. ii. 1. [N.B. Note sudivasaH, supraBAtam etc. are not used in the English sense for which use kuSalaM te, kuSalaM BavataH, etc. or svAgatam to a visitor]; as g. as (i.e. in effect): vastutaH.

‘to make good,’ sampad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), sampF (c. 10. -pUrayati -yituM), sAD (c. 10. sADayati -yituM); ‘make good a pro- mise,’ pratijYAm apavfj (c. 10. -varjayati -yituM); ‘make good a debt,’ fRaM SuD (c. 10. Grant, v. t. vitF 1 P, dA 3 U, 1 P, pratipad c.; See Give. 2 anuman 4 A, anujYA 9 U, anu-mud 1 A. 3 grah 9 U, aMgIkf 8 U, urIkf, svIkf, pratipad 4 A, aByupagam 1 P, aByupa-i 2 P; ‘I g(rant)’, ‘g(rant)ed’ gen. ex. by kAmaM followed by tu, taTApi or punaH; or by imp.; ‘well it is g(rant)ed’ Bavatu, evamastu, gfhItamidaM. s. pradAnaM, dAnaM, utsargaH, dAyaH, vihApitaM, upAyanaM; See Gift; ‘g(rant) of property’ nibaMDaH; ‘royal g(rant)’ (gifts of land, &c.) SAsanaM, pawwaH, SAsanapatraM; ‘a written g(rant)’ leKapatraM. [Grant]ee, s. pratigrahItf m., dAnaBogin m., AdAtf m. [Grant]or, s. dAtf m.
GRANT (subs.): (1) dAnam, pra-, g. of a village: grAmadAnam, He.;(2) SAsanam (= edict: of royal g.), with g.s attested with his own signature: svahastakftacihnaSAsanaH, Si. xiv. 36.

GRANT (v.t.): I To give: q.v.:(1) dadAti or datte (dA, c. 3.), what does not God g. (when) [Page322] gracious: kiM na dadAti BagavAn prasannaH, Ve.;(2) vitarati (tF, c. 1.), God, g. me whatever is good: tanme BadraM BadraM vitara Bagavan, Ma. i. 4.; to whom excessive powers had been g. ed: vitIrRavIryAtiSayAn, Si. i. 71. Ph.: to g. a request: prarTitaM or kAmaM dadAti, v. p. or aBilAzaM pUrayati.II To con- -cede:(1) svIkaroti (= to admit: q.v.); (2) by aTa or aTo (= g. ed), g. ed the arrow was discharged by him for me: aTo Sarastena madarTa- mujBkitaH, Ki. xiv. 17.;(3) by imper., I g. he is wholly so: taTAviDastAvadaSezamastu saH, Ku.

GRANT , s. pradAnaM, sampradAnaM, dAnaM, dattaM, pradA, vitaraRaM, visarjjanaM, utsargaH, utsarjjanaM, dAyaH, vihApitaM; ‘grant of maintenance,’ vfttidAnaM; ‘a written grant,’ leKapatraM, samarpaRapatraM; ‘a royal grant,’ SAsanaM, SAsanapatraM, pawwaH; ‘grant of property,’ nibanDaH -nDanaM; ‘grant of safe conduct,’ aBayapradArna.

To GRANT , v. a. (Give, confer) dA (c. 3. dadAti, c. 1. yacCati, [Page317-b+ 51] dAtuM), pradA, anudA, vitF (c. 1. -tarati -rituM -rItuM), pratipad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), diS (c. 6. diSati, dezwuM), upakf, upAkf. — (Admit) svIkf, svIkAraM kf, aNgIkf, grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), anugrah. — (Allow) anujYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -nIte -jYAtuM), aByanujYA, anuman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM).

GRATER: GarzaRI (?), GarzaRayantram (?).
GRATER , s. GarzaRI, GarzaRayantraM, nirGarzaRakaH, GarzaRAlaH, AGawwakaH.

GRATIFICATION: I The act:(1) tozaRam, saM-, pari-;(2) tarpaRam, pari-, (rare).II Pleasure, delight: q.v.:(1) santozaH;(2) paritozaH; (3) tuzwiH; receiving g. at night: tuzwimupeyuzAM niSi, N. xvi. iii.III Reward: q.v.: pAritozikam.

GRATIFICATION , s. (Act of pleasing, indulging) santozaRaM, tozaH -zaRaM, tuzwikaraRaM, tuzwidAnaM, tarpaRaM, prItikaraRaM, ArADanaM, anuroDaH -DanaM, anuvarttanaM, prasAdanaM, AnamanaM, AnatiH f.; ‘gratification of an hu- mour,’ CandonuvarttanaM, CandonuvfttaM; ‘of a wish,’ manoraTasidDiH f., icCAsADanaM, icCAdAnaM. — (Pleasure, satisfaction) tuzwiH f., santozaH, [Page318-b+ 51] paritozaH, tozaH, prItiH f., tfptiH f., suKaM, sOrUyaM, AnandaH, AhlAdaH, ratiH f., aBiruciH f.

GRATIFIED , p. p. tuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, santozitaH -tA -taM, parituzwaH -zwA -zwaM, santuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, prItaH -tA -taM, tfptaH -ptA -ptaM, tarpitaH -tA -taM, ArADitaH -tA -taM, prasAditaH -tA -taM, AnanditaH -tA -taM, pramoditaH -tA -taM, prati- grAhitaH -tA -taM; ‘in mind,’ prItamanAH -nAH -naH (s); ‘having every wish gratified,’ sarvvasidDArTaH -rTA -rTaM, pUrRakAmaH -mA -maM, kftArTaH -rTA -rTaM, caritArTaH -rTA -rTaM.

Gratify, v. t. tuz c., saM-pari°, AnaMd c., prI 10, tfp c., pramud c., hfz c., ram c., A-hlad c.; See Delight also. 2 anu-vft 1 A, anuruD 4 A, lal 10, pra-sad c., A-rAD c., anuraMj c., sAMtv 10. 3 Sam c. (Sa-mayati), pF c., or pUr 10, sAD c., nirvft c.; ‘having all desires g(ratifi)ed’ pUrRakAma, kftArTa, kftin, sidDArTa, nivfttakAma; ‘g(ratifi)ed at heart’ prIta-hfzwa-citta. [Gratif]ication, s. saM-, pari-, tozaH, AnaMdaH, tfpti f., tuzwi f., prIti f., suKaM, harzaH, AhlAdaH, pramodaH. 2 ArA-DanaM, anuroDaH, anuvartanaM, prasAdanaM, tarpaRaM, tozaRaM. 3 SAMti f., SamanaM, sidDi f., sADanaM, pUraRaM, nirvartanaM; ‘g(ratification) of desire’ manoraTa-sidDiH, izwasADanaM; ‘g(ratification) of anotherʼs whim’ CaMdonuvftti f., vartanaM. [Gratify]ing, a. saM-paritozaka, tuzwi-prIti-da, suKAvaha, AnaMdaprada, suKa-prIti-kara (rI f.).

GRATIFY: tozayati, saM-, pari-, (c. of tuz), you will g. him and return quick: taM santozya satvaramAgamizyasi, H.; the killer of Vritra was g. ed with his excessive strength: tutoza vIryAtiSayena vftrahA, R. iii. 62: v. To please, satisfy.

To GRATIFY , v. a. (Please) suK (c. 10. suKayati -yituM), santuz (c. 10. -tozayati -yituM), parituz, nand (c. 10. nandayati -yituM), Anand, prI (c. 9. prIRAti, c. 10. prIRayati -yituM), tfp (c. 10. tarpayati -yituM), pramud (c. 10. -modayati -yituM), ram (c. 10. ramayati -yituM), hlAd (c. 10. hlAda- yati -yituM), hfz (c. 10. harzayati -yituM), saBAj (c. 10. saBAjayati -yituM), ruc (c. 1. rocate -cituM) with dat. of person, suKaM kf, prItiM dA. — (Indulge, humour, soothe) anuvft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), ArAD (c. 10. -rADayati -yituM), prasad (c. 10. -sAdayati -yituM), anuraYj (c. 10. -raYjayati -yituM), anuruD (c. 4. -ruDyate -rodDuM), lal (c. 10. lAlayati -yituM).
To GRATIFY , v. a. vinud in caus. GRATIFICATION, vinodaH.

GRATIFYING , part. or a. paritozakaH -kA -kaM, santozakaH -kA -kaM, tuzwikaraH -rA -raM, tuzwidaH -dA -daM, paritozajanakaH -kA -kaM, tuzwijananaH -nI -naM, suKakaraH -rA -raM, suKadaH -dA -daM, prItikaraH -rI -raM, prItidaH -dA -daM, AnandadaH -dA -daM, nandakaH -kA -kaM, tarpI -rpiRI -rpi (n), ramaRaH -RA -RaM, ArADakaH -kA -kaM, anuraYjakaH -kA -kaM.
GRATING (adj.); karkaSaH (SA, SaM), g. to the ear: karRakarkaSaH (SA, SaM), N. xvii. 25.
GRATING (subs.): I Rubbing: saMGarzaRam, g. of teeth: dantasam.II Grate: q.v.
GRATING , part. or a. karkaSaH -SA -SaM, nizWuraH -rA -raM, KaraH -rA -raM, aruntudaH -dA -daM, kawuH -wuH -wvI -wu; ‘to the ears,’ karRakawuH -wuH -wu.
GRATING , s. parasparaGarzaRaM, parasparaGarzaRajaH karkaSaSabdaH. — (Partition of iron bars) lohajAlaM, lOhajAlakaH, vyatyastalohadaRqayuktaM avaroDakaM or vyavaDAnaM.
GRATINGLY: karkaSam; v. Harshly.
GRATINGLY , adv. karkaSaM, nizWuraM, aruntudaM, kawu, kArkaSyena.
Gratis, adv. vinA mUlyena, DarmArTaM, nirmUlyaM.
GRATIS: vinA mUlyena; svataH (= naturally).
GRATIS , adv. mUlyaM vinA, mUlyavyatirekeRa, nirmUlyaM, DarmmArTaM.
GRATITUDE: (1) kftajYatA;(2) kftaveditA.
GRATITUDE , s. kftajYatA, upakArajYatA, upakftajYatA, upakArasmaraRaM, kftopa- kArasmaraRaM, pratyupakArakaraRecCA.
Gratuitous, a. amUlyavat, nirmUlya, mUlyaM-vinA datta, kAmataH datta. 2 amUlaka, nizkA-raRa, nirnimitta, ahetuka. [Gratuitous]ly, adv. nirmUlyaM.
GRATUITOUS: I Given without recompense: expr. by adv.II Without good ground: amUlakaH (kA, kaM).

GRATUITOUS , a. mUlyaM vinA dattaH -ttA -ttaM, nirmUlyaH -lyA -lyaM, prakAmaM or svecCAto dattaH -ttA -ttaM, DarmmArTakaH -kA -kaM; ‘gratuitous labour,’ vizwiH f. — (Groundless) ahetukaH -kA -kaM, nirnimittaH -ttA -ttaM, nizkAraRaH -RA -RaM.
GRATUITOUSLY: (1) vinA mUlyena;(2) svataH (= naturally: q.v.).
GRATUITOUSLY , adv. mUlyaM vinA, mUlyavyatirekeRa, DarmmArTaM, nirmUlyaM.
Gratuity, s. pradAnaM, upAyanaM; See Gift.
GRATUITY: dAnam: v. Present, gift.
GRATUITY , s. pAritozikaM, SulkaH -lkaM, upAyanaM, pradAnaM, dAnaM.
To GRATULATE , v. a. aBinand (c. 1. -nandati -ndituM), aBivand (c. 1. -vandate -ndituM), kalyARavacanaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), kalyaM vad, kuSala- vAdaM kf. See CONGRATULATE.
GRATULATION , s. aBinandA -ndanaM, aBivandanaM, kalyARavAdaH, kalyavAdaH.
GRATULATORY , a. kalyavAdI -dinI -di (n), aBinandakaH -kA -kaM.
Gravamen, s. pIqA, duHKaM.

Grave, a. guru, mahat, alaGu. 2 ga(gaM)BIra, DIra, acapala. 3 (Sound) maMda, Gana, gaMBIra, DIra, maMdra, maMTara; ‘g(rave) matter’ gurvarTaH. s. preta-Sava-sTAnaM; samADiH, SmaSAnaM, avawaH; ‘g(rave) clothes’ pretavAsas n., SavavastraM; ‘g(rave)-stone’ cityaM, cEtyaM, samADiprastaraH. v. t. takz 1, 5 P, tvakz 1 P. [Grave]ly, adv. gaMBIra-tayA, DIraM, sagOravaM, gAMBIryeRa. 2 maMdraM, DIraM, gaMBIraM. [Grave]ness, s. gurutA-tvaM, gOravaM, mahattvaM. Gravity, s. gurutvaM, BAraH. 2 gOravaM, gurutvaM-tA, mahiman m., gAMBIryaM; alAGavaM, DIratA, maMdratA. 3 AkarzaRaSIlatA, AkarzaRaSakti f. Gravitate, v. i. Akfz pass., aDaH gam or pat 1 P. [Gravitat]ion, s. AkarzaRaM, aDaHpatana-SIlatA.

GRAVE (adj.): I Heavy: q.v.: guru (f. rvI). II Important: q.v.: guru (f. rvI).III Solemn:(1) gamBI(BI)raH (rA, raM) (= deep); (2) DIraH (rA, raM) (= steady).IV Of sound: (1) gamBi(BI)raH (rA, raM);(2) mandra (f. ndrA);(3) DIraH (rA, raM);(4) GanaH (nA, naM).
GRAVE (subs.): I Lit.: SavaKAtam (?).II Tomb: q.v.: samADiH.III Death, end: q.v.: antaH.
GRAVE (v.): mudrayati (mudr, c. 10.): v. To engrave.
GRAVE , s. (Place for the dead) samADiH m., avawaH, SmaSAnaM, mftaSarI- rasTAnaM, equkaM, sanDiH m., SavavAsaH, SavagarttaH.

GRAVE , a. (Serious) guruH -rvvI -ru, alaGuH -GuH -Gu, mandaH -ndA -ndaM, jaqaH -qA -qaM. — (Momentous) gurvarTaH -rTA -rTaM, bahvarTaH -rTA -rTaM, gamBIrArTaH -rTA -rTaM, — (Deep in sound) gamBIraH -rA -raM, gaBIraH -rA -raM, mandraH -ndrA -ndraM, mandaH -ndA -ndaM, manTaraH -rA -raM, AmandraH -ndrA -ndraM, DIraH -rA -raM, GanaH -nA -naM. — (In grammar) plutaH -taM; ‘the grave accent,’ anudAttaH.
To GRAVE , v. a. and n. takz (c. 1. takzati -kzituM, c. 5. takzRoti), tvakz (c. 1. [Page319-a+ 51] tvakzati -kzituM), mudra (nom. mudrayati -yituM), mudrIkf.
GRAVE-CLOTHE: pretavAsas (n.), covering the emperor with g.: mahArAjaM vAsasA samAcCAdya, Ram. ii. 83. 15.
GRAVE-CLOTHES , s. SavavastraM, SavAcCAdanaM, mftaSarIrapariDAnaM.
GRAVE-DIGGER: SavaKAtaKanakaH. (?).
GRAVE-DIGGER , s. samADiKanakaH, avawaKanitA m. (tf), SavagarttaKanakaH.
GRAVE-STONE: niDAnopalaH (?); niDAnaprastaraH (?).
GRAVE-STONE , s. cityaM, cEtyaM, cEtraH, citAcUqakaM, mftajanasmaraRaprastaraH, SmaSAnaprastaraH, samADiprastaraH.

Gravel, s. SarkarA, vAlukA, SilA-pAzARa-KaMqaH-cUrRaM. 2 (Disease) aSmarI, mUtrakfcCraM, mUtra-SarkarA. v. t. SarkarAvfta a. kf 8 U. 2 muh c., saM-vi-Bram c. (Bramayati). [Gravel]ly, a. saSarkara, Sarkarita, SarkarAvfta, SarkarAvat, SArkarIya.
GRAVEL (subs.): SarkarA (= both the earth and the disease).
GRAVEL (v.): I Lit.: SarkarAvftaM (f. tAM) or SarkarAcCannaM (f. nnAM) karoti.II Fig.: v. To entangle, embarrass.
GRAVEL , s. SarkarA, bAlukA, cUrRaKaRqaH, cUrRaH -rRaM, SilAKaRqaH, pAzARaKaRqaH, SilAcUrRaM, pAzARacUrRaM. — (The disease) SarkarA, aSmarI, aSmIraH -raM, mUtraKaRqaH, pARquSarkarA.
To GRAVEL , v. a. saSarkaraM -rAM -raM kf, SarkarAnvitaM -tAM -taM kf, SarkarAvftaM -tAM -taM kf, SarkarIkf. — (Perplex) vimuh (c. 10. -mohayati -yituM), SalyaM kf.
GRAVEL-WALK , s. SarkarAvftaH paTaH, SarkarAvAn udyAnamArgaH.
GRAVELLY: (1) SrkarAvat (f. tI);(2) SArkarikaH (kI, kaM).
GRAVELLY , a. SArkarIyaH -yI -yaM, SArkaraH -rI -raM, SArkarakaH -kA -kaM, SarkarAvAn -vatI -vat (t), SarkarikaH -kI -kaM, SarkarilaH -lA -laM, saSarkaraH -rA -raM.
GRAVELY: (1) gamBIram;(2) DIram: v. Grave (adj.).
GRAVELY , adv. guru, alaGu, gOraveRa, sagOravaM, gamBIraM, BAvagamBIraM, gAmBIryyeRa, DIraM, mandaM.
GRAVEN , p. p. tazwaH -zwA -zwaM, takzitaH -tA -taM, mudritaH -tA -taM.
GRAVENESS , s. gurutA -tvaM, gOravaM, garimA m. (n), gamBIratA, gAmBIryyaM, DIratvaM -tA, alaGutA, alAGavaM, jaqatA, jAqyaM.
GRAVEOLENCE , s. durganDaH, kutsitaganDaH, dOrganDi n., pUtiganDaH.
Graveolent, a. durgaMDa, pUtigaMDi.
GRAVEOLENT , a. durganDI -nDinI -nDi (n), kutsitaganDaH -nDA -nDaM.
GRAVER , s. takzakaH, tazwA m. (zwf), takzaRakarttA m. (rttf), mudrAkaraH.
GRAVEYARD: pretavanam: v. Cemetery.
GRAVID , a. garBiRI, garBavatI, pUrRagarBA, gfhItagarBA, antarApatyA.
GRAVING , s. takzaRaM, takzaRakarmma n. (n), takzaRakAryyaM.
GRAVITATE: Akfzyate (pass of kfz), g.s. (lit. is drawn) towards it according to the law of g. ion (lit. by its force): Akfzyate svABimuKaM svaSaktyA, Go. iii. 5.

To GRAVITATE , v. n. svaBAragurutvAd BUmiM prati pat (c. 1. patati -tituM) or pat in des. (pipatizati -zituM, pitsati) or aDaH pat, or aDo gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM) or anyamUrttiM prati Akfz in pass. (-kfzyate).
GRAVITATION: AkarzaRam. Law of g.: AkarzaRaSaktiH.
GRAVITATION , s. svaBAragurutvAd BUmiM prati patanaSIlatA or pAtukatvaM or pipatizA or aDaHpAtukatA or anyamUrttiM prati AkarzaRaSIlatA.
GRAVITY: I Heaviness: gurutvam, specific g.: viSezagurutvam.II Weight, importance: q.v.: gurutvam.III Solemnity:(1) gAmBIryam;(2) DEryB (= steadiness).IV Of sound:(1) gAmmIryam; (2) mandratA.

GRAVITY , s. (Weight) gurutvaM, gOravaM, garimA m. (n), BAraH, BAragurutA. — (Seriousness) gurutA, gOravaM, gamBIratA, gAmBIryyaM, DIratvaM -tA, alaGutA, alAGavaM, jaqatA, jAqyaM, mandatA. — (Tendency of a body towards the earth, or towards another body) svaBAragurutvAd BUmiM prati pAtukatvaM or anyamUrttiM prati AkarzaRaSIlatA. — (Specific gravity) BAramAnaM.
GRAVITY , s. (Centre of) gurutvakendaM.
Gravy, s. mAMsasAraH, mAMsajUzaM.
GRAVY: sidDamAMsarasaH, Bha.
GRAVY , s. mAMsayUzaM, mAMsajUzaM, mAMsavyaYjanaM, vyaYjanaM, upaskaraH, temanaM, lAla- sIkaM, prahitaM, mizwAnnaM, pradigDaH.
