details.body: Gray, a. ApAMqu, DUsara, pAMSuvarRa, ASukla. 2 Sukla, Davala, Sveta, pakva, palita (hair); ‘g(ray) beard’ jIrRakUrcaM; ‘g(ray) head’ palitaM SiraH; ‘g(ray)-haired’ palita, Davala-Sukla-keSa; ‘g(ray)-headed’ palitaSiras. 3 jIrRa, pariRata, pakva, vfdDa. s. DUsaraH, DUsara-pAMSu-varRaH. [Gray]ish, a. ApAMqu, pAMqura, ADUsara; ‘g(rayish) with dust’ DUliDUsara. [Gray]ness, s. DUsaratA, palitatA, keSa-DAvalyaM, pakvatA, jIrRatA.

GRAY (adj.): (1) pARqu (mfn.) (= pale white), covered with ash-g. hair: BasmapARquromASlizwaH (zwA, zwaM), K.;(2) DavalaH (lA, laM) (= white: q.v.) g. old age: DavalA jarA, K.;(3) DUmra (f. mrA) (= smoky: q.v.), g. eyed: DUmrAkza (f. kzI), Ram.; (4) palitaH (tA, taM) (of the head and of old men), a man is not old because his head is g.: na tena sTaviro Bavati yenAsya palitaM SiraH, Mah.; gray for nothing: vfTA palitaH, Si.; not by g. (hairs): na palitEH, Mah.
GRAY (subs.): I The colour: v. Gray (adj.).II A g. animal: expr. by white, g. horse: SuklASvaH.

GRAY , a. DUsaraH -rI -raM, DUzaraH -rI -raM, pAMSuvarRaH -rRA -rRaM, BasmavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, IzatpARquH -RquH -Rqu, IzadDavalaH -lA -laM, ASuklaH -klA -klaM, SuklakfzRaH -zRA -zRaM. — (As the hair) palitaH -tA -taM, DavalaH -lA -laM, pakvaH -kvA -kvaM; ‘gray hair,’ palitaM. — (Old) jIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, vfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, pakvaH -kvA -kvaM.
GRAY , s. (The colour) DUsaraH, DUzaraH, DUsaravarRaH, pAMSuvarRaH.
GRAY-BEARD , s. SuklaSmaSruH m., DavalaSmaSruH m., jIrRakUrccaH.
GRAY-EYED , a. pARqunayanaH -nA -naM, DUsaranetraH -trA -traM.
GRAY-HAIRED , a. palitaH -tA -taM, paliknI f., DavalakeSaH -SI -SaM, SuklakeSaH -SI -SaM, pakvakeSaH -SI -SaM.
GRAY-HEADED , a. palitaSirAH -rAH -raH (s), palitamastakaH -kA -kaM.
GRAYISH: (1) pARqu (mfn.) (?);(2) pARquraH (rA, raM).
GRAYISH , a. IzadDUsaraH -rA -raM, ADUsaraH -rA -raM, IzatpAMSuvarRaH -rRA -rRaM.
GRAYLING , s. KacCanadIjo matsyapraBedaH.
GRAYNESS: palitam: v. Gray (4).
GRAYNESS , s. DUsaratvaM, DUsaravarRatvaM, pAMSuvarRatvaM. — (Of the hair) palitaM, keSaDAvalyaM, keSaSuklatA, keSapakvatA. — (Oldness) vfdDatvaM, jIrRatA, pakvatA.

Graze, v. t. car c., tfRaM Buj c. or KAd c. 2 nirGfz 1 P, laGu taq 10, laGuprahAreRa ati-i 2 P. v. i. car 1 P, tfRaM KAd 1 P or Bakz 10 or Buj 7 A; ‘a place g(raz)ed by cattle’ ASitaMgavInaM [Graz]er, s. tfRaBakzakaH. [Graz]ing, s. caraRaM; ‘g(razing) ground’ gocaraH, go-pracAraH. Grazier, s. gocArakaH, paSupAlaH, gopAlakaH.

GRAZE (v.): I To feed on: carati (car, c. 1.), for g. ing at a distance: dUre caraRAya, Pa.; g. grass: tfRaM caranti, Pa.II To feed: cArayati, saM-, pra-, (c. of car), to g. calves: vatsAMScArayati. V.p.III To touch slightly: Garzati, (Gfz, c. 1.).

To GRAZE , v. a. (Touch lightly, rub) Gfz (c. 1. Garzati -rzituM), laGu taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM), laGugatyA atikramya Gfz. — (Feed cattle with grass) car in caus. (cArayati -yituM), tfRam aS in caus. (ASayati -yituM) or Buj in caus. (Bojayati -yituM) or KAd in caus. (KAdayati -yituM), tfRaM dA.
To GRAZE , v. n. (Feed on grass) car (c. 1. carati -rituM), tfR (c. 8. tarRoti, tfRoti, tarRituM), tfRaM KAd (c. 1. KAdati -dituM) or aS (c. 9. aSnAti, aSituM) or Bakz (c. 10. Bakzayati -yituM).
GRAZED , p. p. (Rubbed) GfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, GarzitaH -tA -taM, laGu tAqitaH -tA -taM. — (Eaten by cattle) gocaritaH -tA -taM, goBakzitaH -tA -taM, ASitaNgavInaH -nA -naM, aSitaNgavInaH -nA -naM.
GRAZER: tfRacArin (f. RI), Pa.
GRAZER , s. tfRaKAdakaH, tfRaBakzakaH, tfRASI m. (n), caritA m. (tf).
GRAZIER: cArakaH, N.s. Cattle-g.: gocArakaH.
GRAZIER , s. gocArakaH, gavAdicArakaH, gopAlakaH, paSupozakaH.
GRAZING (subs.): I The act:(1) caraRam;(2) pracAraH.II G. land:(1) pracAraBUmiH, V.p. com.;(2) gocaraH (for king), Ki.III Rubb- -ing: A-GarzaRam.
GRAZING , s. gocaraH -raRaM, gopracAraH, pracAraH, tfRaKAdanaM.

Grease, s. vasA, medas n., vapA, mAMsasnehaH-sAraH. 2 snehaH, tElaM, GftaM. v. t. vasayA-sne-hena lip 6 P or aMj 7 P or dih 2 U. [Greas]y, a. medasvin, vasAmaya (yI f.), cikkaRa, pra-, snigDa, vasAkta, snehAByakta, sasneha, vasA-sneha-yukta.
GREASE (subs.): (1) vasA;(2) vapA;(3) medas (n.).
GREASE (v.): I Lit.: vasayA SlakzRIkaroti: v. Also to smear.II To bribe: q.v.
GREASE , s. vasA, GftaM, medas n., snehaH, mAMsasnehaH, mAMsasAraH, vapA, tElaM, tilasnehaH, aByaYjanaM.

To GREASE , v. a. vasayA or Gftena or snehena lip (c. 6. limpati, leptuM) or aYj (c. 7. anakti, aMktuM, c. 10. aYjayati -yituM) or dih (c. 2. degDi -gDuM), GftAktaM -ktAM -ktaM kf, snigDIkf, snehAktIkf.
GREASED , p. p. vasAliptaH -ptA -ptaM, GftAByaktaH -ktA -ktaM, snehAktaH -ktA -ktaM, vasAByaktaH -ktA -ktaM, GftokzitaH -tA -taM, aByaktaH -ktA -ktaM.
GREASILY: I Lit. cikkaRam.II Grossly: aSlIlam.
GREASILY , adv. cikkaRaM, snigDaM, vasayA, sasnehaM, saGftaM, Gftena.
GREASINESS , s. cikkaRatA -tvaM, snigDatA, snEgDyaM, GftAktatvaM, GftavattvaM, snehavattvaM, sasnehatvaM, medasvitA, vasAliptatA.
GREASY: I Oily: vasAplutaH (tA, taM) (after Gfta- plutaH of N.).II Smooth: q.v.: cikkaRaH (RA, RaM).

GREASY , a. vasAmayaH -yI -yaM, GftavAn -vatI -vat (t), GftAktaH -ktA -ktaM, vasAByaktaH -ktA -ktaM, cikkaRaH -RA -RaM, snigDaH -gDA -gDaM, snehavAn -vatI -vat (t), sasnehaH -hA -haM, snehI -hinI -hi (n), snehAktaH -ktA -ktaM, medasvI -svinI -svi (n), prameditaH -tA -taM, vasAyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, satElaH -lA -laM.

Great, a. mahat, guru, bfhat, viSAla, vipula, vi-stIrRa, uru, pfTu, sTUla, mahApramARa. 2 (In number) bahu, BUri, pracura, bahula, bahusaM-KyAka. 3 utkfzwa, uttama, parama, viSizwa, vi-Sruta, SrezWa, labDapratizWa, prasidDa, mahAyaSaska. 4 mahecCa, mahASaya, mahAtman, udAra, udAracitta. 5 praDAna, muKya, parama, agrya, guru. 6 atyaMta, atimAtra, gAQa, aDika, BfSa, parama, ekAMta, nitAMta, atirikta; oft. by mahat, su, ati, in comp.; ‘to a g(reat) distance’, sudUraM, atidUraM; ‘to a g(reat) degree’ BfSaM, atimAtraM, atyaMtaM, nirBaraM, gAQaM. [Great]ly, adv. BfSaM, atyaMtaM, sAti-SayaM, su-ni-tarAM, ekAMtataH, paraM, balavat, gAQaM, paramaM, su-ati-atiSaya in comp.; See Exceedingly; oft. ex. by kowi f., kAzWA; ‘he was g(reatly) delighted’ AnaMdasya parAM kowiM-kAzWAM-aDigatavAn. [Great]ness, s. mahattvaM, mAhAtmyaM, mahiman m., gurutvaM; vipulatA, viSAlatA, &c. 2 vistAraH, parimARaM. 3 viSruti f., utkarzaH, viSizwatA, paramatA, A-DikyaM, pratizWA, gOravaM. 4 vEBavaM, SoBA, ESvaryaM; See Grandeur; ‘g(reatness) of mind’ OdAryaM, mAhAtmyaM; ‘g(reatness) of rank’ kulInatA, aBijAtya, kulotkarzaH.

GREAT: (1) mahat (f. tI): in most senses: (a) of size: a g. forest: mahAvanam, Mu.: v. Large. (b) of quantity: g. collection: mahAnnicayaH, Ki.; a g. crowd: mahAjanasamUhaH, Ku. (c) of weight: g. news: mahatI vArttA, H.; for g. result: mahate PalAya, Ki.: v. Important. (d) eminent, noble: of the g.: mahatAm, Ki.; g. man: mahAjanaH, Mah.; g. -minded: mahAtman (mfn.), K.: v. Principal, chief. (e) of degree, etc.: a g. while: mahAn kAlaH, K.; g. effort: mahAn yanwaH, R.; g. sinner: mahApAtakin, Vi.; of g. price: mahArha (f. rhA), Ku.; g. interval: mahandataram. P.;(2) su (= good) or ati (= very) prefixed (to intensify the meaning), to a g. distance: suwUram, K.; g. many: subahu (mfn.), K.; to a g. degree: atyarTam, Ki.; (3) aDikaH (kA, kaM) (when there is compari- -son), the g. animals did not harass the little: UnaM na sattvezvaDiko babADe, R. ii. 14.; g. er devotion: aDikA BaktiH, K.: v. More.

GREAT , a. (Large) mahAn -hatI -hat (t), vfhan -hatI -hat (t), viSAlaH -lA -laM, vipulaH -lA -laM, pfTuH -TuH -TvI -Tu, pfTulaH -lA -laM, uruH -ruH -ru, sTUlaH -lA -laM, vikawaH -wA -waM, karAlaH -lA -laM, viSaNkawaH -wA -wI -waM, vaqraH -qrA -qraM, UrjjitaH -tA -taM. — (Great in number, a great many) bahuH -huH -hvI -hu, bahulaH -lA -laM, bahusaMKyakaH -kA -kaM, BUriH -riH -ri, pracuraH -rA -raM. — (Extensive) vistIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, pfTuparimARaH -RA -RaM. — (Noble, eminent) mahAtmA -tmA -tma (n), viSrutaH -tA -taM, mahAyaSaskaH -skA -skaM, prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, SrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, mahABAgaH -gA -gaM, pratizWaH -zWA -zWaM. — (Chief, principal) praDAna in comp., muKyaH -KyA -KyaM, agraH -grA -graM, paramaH -mA -maM. — (Important) guruH -rvvI -ru, paramaH -mA -maM, alaGuH -GuH -Gu. — (Ex- pressing a great degree of any thing) ati or su or mahA prefixed, atyantaH -ntA -ntaM, gAQaH -QA -QaM, atimAtraH -trA -traM, aDikaH -kA -kaM, nitAntaH -ntA -ntaM, ekAntaH -ntA -ntaM, BfSaH -SA -SaM, atiriktaH -ktA -ktaM, paraH -rA -raM; ‘great fear,’ mahABayaM, atiBayaM; ‘great vigour,’ suvIryyaM; ‘great heat,’ atidAhaH, sudAhaH, gurutApaH; ‘great rain,’ BUrivfzwiH f.; ‘to a great distance,’ sudUraM -re -ratas, atidUraM -re; ‘to a great degree,’ atyantaM, atyarTaM, atimAtraM, BfSaM, atiSayaM -yena, nirBaraM, gAQaM, bahu; ‘great grandson,’ prapOtraH; ‘great grandfather,’ prapitAmahaH; ‘a great many people’ bahujanAH m. pl.

GREAT , s. (The whole) sAkalyaM, samudAyaH, samAsaH, samastiH f., sAmagryaM. — (Great people) kulInajanAH m. pl., sevyajanAH m. pl., utkfzwapadasTAH m. pl., mahAjanAH m. pl.; ‘fit for the great,’ mAhAjanikaH -kI -kaM.
GREAT-COAT: not equiv.: *mahAcolaH.
GREAT-COAT , s. uttarIyaM, uttarIyavastraM, prAvAraH -rakaH, nicolaH -lI.
GREAT-HEARTED , GREAT-MINDED, a. mahAtmA -tmA -tma (n), mahAmanAH -nAH -naH (s), udAracetAH -tAH -taH (s), mahAsattvaH -ttvA -ttvaM, mahecCaH -cCA -cCaM.

GREATER , a. mahattaraH -rA -raM, viSAlataraH -rA -raM, vfhattaraH -rA -raM, gurutaraH -rA -raM, garIyAn -yasI -yaH (s), uttaraH -rA -raM. — (Greater num- ber) bahutaraH -rA -raM, BUyAn -yasI -yaH (s), BUyizWaH -zWA -zWaM, aDikaH -kA -kaM, aDikataraH -rA -raM, paraH -rA -raM, parataraH -rA -raM, aparaH -rA -raM; ‘greater and greater,’ aDikADikaM, uttarottaraM.
GREATEST: in degree: paramaH (mA, maM): v. Extreme. In the g. degree: param: v. Extremely.

GREATEST , a. mahattamaH -mA -maM, vfhattamaH -mA -maM, sumahAn -hatI -hat (t). gurutamaH -mA -maM, garizWaH -zWA -zWaM, aDikatamaH -mA -maM; ‘in the greatest degree,’ suBfSaM, sumahat, atimahat, sutarAM, atitarAM.

GREATLY: I Much, exceedingly: q.v.: (1) ati- or su- in comp.;(2) atiSayam;(3) BfSam. Very g.: sutarAm, nitarAm, or atitarAm, his love was very g. implanted: sutarAmAropitaprItiraBavat, K. II Nobly: q.v.: by adj.

GREATLY , adv. (In a great degree) su or ati or atiSaya pre- fixed, BfSaM, suBfSaM, atyantaM, nirBaraM, atiSayaM -yena, atimAtraM, atyarTaM, BUri, gAQaM, nitAntaM, sutarAM, atitarAM, aDikaM, atIva, paraM, balavat; ‘greatly grieved,’ suduHKitaH -tA -taM. — (Nobly) mAhAtmyena, udAravat.

GREATNESS: (1) mahattvam, for accession of g.: mahattva- yogAya, Ki. iii. 23.;(2) mahiman (m.), the chief of devotees domineers with her g.: praBavati hi mahimnA svena yogeSvarIyam, Ma. x. 8.: v. Eminence, grandeur;(3) gurutvam (= importance: q.v.); (4) udAratA (= magnanimity: q.v.);(5) vipulatA (= largeness: q.v.).

GREATNESS , s. (Largeness) mahattvaM, mahimA m. (n), vfhattvaM, viSAlatA, vipulatA, pfTutA -tvaM, praTimA m. (n), pArTavaM, sTUlatA, sTOlyaM, urutA -tvaM, vikawatA, vEkawyaM, vraqimA m. (n), parivraqimA m. — (Extent) vistIrRatA, suvistIrRatA. — (Bulk) parimARaM. — (Eminence) utkarzaH, utkfzwatA, prasidDatA, SrezWatvaM, yaSasvitA, viSrutiH f., ADikyaM. — (Grandeur) viBUtiH f., vEBavaM, praBAvaH, ESvaryyaM. — (Greatness of mind) mAhAtmyaM, udAratA, OdAryyaM. — (Of rank) kulInatA, kulotkarzaH, aBijAtatA, sevyatA.
Greaves, s. jaMGA-Uru-trARaM, maMkzukzaRaM.
GREAVES: jaNGAtrARam and sim. comp.s.
GREAVES , s. pl. jaNGAtrARaM, maMkzaRaM, maMkzuRaM, jaNGAkavacaM, jaNGArakzaRI, UrutrARaM, Uruvarmma n. (n).
GRECIAN: I Adj.:(1) by comp.;(2) *AgrikaH (kI, kaM).II Subs; (a) a Greek: *agrikaH (b.) one versed in Greek: *agrika- BAzAjYaH.
GRECIAN , a. grIkadeSIyaH -yA -yaM, grIkadeSajaH -jA -jaM, yAvanaH -nI -naM, yavanIyaH -yA -yaM, yavanadeSIyaH -yA -yaM.
GRECIAN , s. grIkadeSavAsI m. (n), yavanaH, yavanadeSajaH.
GRECISM: *agrikaBAzARusAriRI vAkpadDatiH.
GRECISM , s. grIkaBAzAnusAriRI vAgvfttiH, grIkaBAzAsampradAyaH.
GREECE , s. grIkradeSaH, yavanaH, yavanadeSaH.

Greed, s. loBaH, gfDnutA, atispfhA, lOlyaM, lubDatA, atyaBilAzaH, atilipsA, atyA-kAMkzA, lolupatvaM, atfpti f., aparitozaH. 2 (Of food) atyAhAraH, GasmaratA, admaratA, udaraMBaritvaM. Greedy, a. lubDa, lolupa, loluBa, gfDnu, loBAvizwa, atyaBilAzin, atyAkAMkzin, satfzRa, atitfzRAkula, ati-loBin. 2 AhAralubDa, atyAhArapriya, Ga-smara, admara, atiBojin, bahuBuj, Odarika, udaraMBari, kukziMBari, bahuBakzaka; ‘to be g(reedy)’ gfD 4 P, luB 4 P. [Greedi]ly, adv. atiloBena, saloBaM, satfzRaM, lolupatayA, jihvAlOlyAt, atyaBilAzeRa, atispfhayA. [Greedy]ness, s. loBaH; See (s.).
GREEDILY , adv. atiloBena -BAt, atilOlyAt, lubDajanavat, gfDravat, atiSayalipsayA, atiSayajiGfkzayA, loBAveSAt, atyaBilAzeRa, atI- cCayA, atispfhAtas.
GREEDINESS, GREED: I Covetousness: q.v.: gfDnutA.II Voracity:(1) GasmaratA or ahmaratA; (2) jiGatsA,: v. Hunger.

GREEDINESS , s. lubDatA, loBavattvaM, loBaH, atiBojanaM, atyAhAraH, gfDratA, gfDrutA, atibuBukzA, aDikaBojanaM, GasmaratA, lolatA, lOlyaM, admaratA, atfptiH f., aparitozaH, atyAkAMkzA, atilipsA, lipsAtiSayaH, udara- BaraRaM, jiGfkzA, gardDaH, BakzakatvaM, atyaBilAzaH, atispfhA.

GREEDY: I Covetous: q.v.: gfDnu (mfn.). II Of food:(1) ahmaraH or GasmaraH (rA, raM) (= voracious), the g. destructive Rudra: Gasmara- kalarudraH. vi. iii. 48.;(2) jiGatsu (mfn.) (= wish- -ing to eat): v. Hungry.

GREEDY , a. (Voracious) lubDaH -bDA -bDaM, AhAralubDaH -bDA -bDaM, loBI -BinI -Bi (n), BakzakaH -kA -kaM, bahuBakzakaH -kA -kaM, bahvASI -SinI -Si (n), bahuBuk m. f. n., GasmaraH -rA -raM, admaraH -rA -raM, gfDraH -DrA -DraM, gfDnuH -DnuH -Dnu, garDI -rDinI -rDi (n), garDanaH -nA -naM, jiDfkzuH -kzuH -kzu, buBukzuH -kzuH -kzu, atiBojI -jinI -ji (n), atyAhArI -riRI -ri (n), aparimitAhArI &c., kukzimBariH -riH -ri, udaramBariH -riH -ri, AtmamBariH -riH -ri, OdarikaH -kI -kaM, svodarapUrakaH -kA -kaM, udarapiSAcaH -cI -caM, loluBaH -BA -BaM, lolaH -lA -laM, lolupaH -pA -paM, loBAvizwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Eagerafter) atyaBilAzI -ziRI -zi (n), aBilAzakaH -kA -kaM, atIcCaH -cCA -cCaM, tfzRakaH -kA -kaM, atyAkAMkzI -kziRI -kzi (n), matsaraH -rA -raM; ‘to be greedy,’ gfD (c. 4. gfDyati, garDituM), luB (c. 4. luByati, lobDuM).
GREEK: i.e. G. language: *agrikaBAzA. For other senses: v. Grecian.
GREEK , a. grIkadeSIyaH -yA -yaM, yavanadeSIyaH -yA -yaM.
GREEK , s. grIkadeSajaH, yavanadeSavAsI m. (n), yavanaH. — (Language of Greece) grIkaBAzA.

Green, a. harita, harit, haridvarRa; pa(pA)-lASa. 2 nava, pratyagra, aBinava. 3 aparipakva, apariRata; ‘g(reen)-headed’ apariRataprajYa, apakvaDI. s. haridvarRaH, haritaH, harit m., pAlASavarRaH. 2 haritasTAnaM, SAdvalaM, SAdvala-sTalI, tfRAvftA BUmiH; ‘g(reen)-leaved’ haritparRa; ‘g(reen)-room’ nepaTyaSAlA; ‘g(reen)-sward’ haritaBUmiH, tfRAvftaM sTAnaM, haritakaM, SAkAdi. [Green]ish, a. IzadDarita, haridABa, IzatpalASa. [Green]ness, s. haritatvaM, palASatvaM. 2 apariRatatvaM, aparipAkaH, apakvatA.

GREEN (adj.): I Of colour:(1) haritaH (tA, tAM) or harit (mfn.), about g. paddy: harite DAnye, M. viii. 330.;(2) palASaH (SA, SaM) (rare), a wood g. like new leaves: navapalASapalASavanam, Si. vi. 2.II Fresh: q.v.: g. manhood: navavayas; g. crop: navaSsyam.III Raw, immature: q.v.: apariRataH (tA, taM).IV Not dry, as of g. wood: Ardra. (f. rdrA).
GREEN (subs.): I The colour:(1) haritaH;(2) haridvarRaH;(3) palASaH (rare).II A grassy plain: SAdvalasTalI: v. Also grassy.III In pl., vegetables: SAkam.
GREEN, TO BE or BECOME: haritAyate (nomi.) (rare).

GREEN , a. haritaH -tA -riRI -taM, harit m. f. n., haritavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, haridvarRaH -rRA -rRaM, hariH -riH -ri, palASaH -SI -SaM, pAlASaH -SI -SaM, SyAmaH -mA -maM, BaritaH -tA -taM, tAlakABaH -BA -BaM, SyAmavarRaH -rRA -rRaM; ‘green wood,’ ArdrakAzWaM; ‘to make green,’ haritIkf; ‘to become green,’ harita (nom. haritAyate).
GREEN , s. (The colour) harit m., haritaH, hariH m., pAlASaH, tAla- kABaH. — (Grassy plat) haritatfRAvfto BUmiBAgaH, haritasTAnaM, hari- tasTalaM -sTAnaM.
GREEN-FINCH , s. haritapakzayuktaH pakziBedaH.
GREEN-GROCER , s. SAkaPalAdivikretA m. (tf), SAkAdivikrayI m. (n).
GREEN-HOUSE , s. bAlavfkzAdirakzaRArTaM kAcapawalaM gfhaM.
GREEN-LEAVED , a. haritaCadaH -dA -daM, harityarRaH -rRA -rRaM, haritapatraH -trA -traM.
GREEN-ROOM , s. SARI, nepaTyaM, nepaTyaSAlA.

details.body: GREEN-SICKNESS , s. strIrogaviSezo yasmin muKaM SyAmavarRaM Bavati dehasya cAvasAdo jAyate.
GREEN-SWARD , s. GAsAvftA BUmiH, haritaBUmiH, satfRasTalaM.
GREENED , p. p. haritIkftaH -tA -taM, haritIBUtaH -tA -taM.
GREENFINCH: pakziBedaH; hArItaH (?).
GREENGAGE: no equiv.: *palASaPalam.
GREENGAGE , s. haritavarRaH PalaviSezaH.
GREENGROCER: PalAdivikretf (f. trI); Palopa- jIvin (f. nI), Ram. ii. 90. 19.
GREENHORN: (1) apariRatabudDi (mfn.);(2) apakvaDI (n. Di); etc.
GREENHORN , s. avipakvabudDiH m., apakvaDIH m., akovidaH.
GREENHOUSE: *AtapatrARam; haritagfham.
GREENISH , a. IzadDaritaH -tA -taM, IzatpalASaH -SI -SaM, ASyAmaH -mA -maM.
GREENNESS: I Lit.: haritatA, -tvam.II Fresh- -ness: navatA.III Immaturity: apakratA.
GREENNESS , s. haritatvaM, harittvaM, palASatA, pAlASatA, SyAmatA -tvaM. — (Immaturity) apakvatA, avipakvatA; ‘of mind,’ apakvabudDitvaM.
GREENS , s. pl. SAkAdi n., haritakaM, KAdanIyaSAkAH m. pl.
GREENSIH: (1) IzadDaritaH (tA, taM);(2) haridABaH (BA, BaM).
GREENSWARD: tfRAvftA BUmiH and sim. comp.s.
GREENWOOD (adj.): by comp., g. shade: harita- vanadDAyA.

Greet, v. t. aBinaMd 1 P or c., saBAj 10, vaMd 1 A, aBivad c. (A.), arc 1 P, 10, saM-BU c., satkf 8 U, pUj 10; namaskf, praRam 1 P; ‘g(reet) in return’ pratinaMd, pratyaBi-vad c. [Greet]ing, s. praRAmaH, praRati f., aBivaMdanaM, aBinaMdanaM, namaskAraH, aBivAdaH-vAdanaM, kuSalavAdaH-praSnaH.

GREET (v.): saBAjayati (saBAj, c. 10.), coming to g. (his daughter) out of affection: snehAtsaBA- [Page325] -jayitumetya, U. i. 7.; uses the right arm to g. me: saBAjane me savyetaraM BujaM prayuMkte, Ram. xiii. 43.: v. Also salute.

To GREET , v. a. aBinand (c. 1. -nandati -ndituM), aBivand (c. 1. -vandate -ndituM), vand, aBivad (c. 10. -vAdayate -ti -yituM), kuSalavAkyEr aBivad or aBiBAz (c. 1. -BAzate -zituM), arc (c. 1. arcati -rcituM, c. 10. arcayati -yituM), aByarc, namaskf, namaskAraM kf, satkf, kuSalavAdaM kf, praRam (c. 1. -Ramati -RantuM), praRatiM kf; ‘to greet in return,’ pratyaBivad, pratyarc.
GREETED , p. p. aBinanditaH -tA -taM, aBivAditaH -tA -taM, kuSalavAkyEH samBAzitaH -tA -taM or aBiBAzitaH -tA -taM, namaskftaH -tA -taM, satkftaH -tA -taM.
GREETER: (1) saBajayitf (f. trI);(2) better by verb.
GREETER , s. aBivAdayitA m. (tf), aBivAdakaH, aBinandakaH.
GREETING: (1) saBAjanam;(2) aBinandanam (= con- -gratulation): v. Also salutation.

GREETING , s. aBinandA -ndanaM, aBivAdaH -danaM, vandanaM, aBivandanaM, kuSala- vAkyEH samBAzaRaM or aBiBAzaRaM, kuSalapraSnaH, satkAraH, satkftiH f., namaskAraH, namaskriyA, kOSalaM -lI, kuSalavAdaH; ‘greeting in return,’ pratyaBivAdaH -danaM.
Gregarious, a. yUTacArin, saMGacArin.
GREGARIOUS: (1) yUyacArin (f. RI) and sim. comp.s. (= moving in company: as of elephants):(2) saNGapriyaH (yA, yaM) and sim. comp.s.
GREGARIOUS , a. yUTacArI -riRI -ri (n), anekacaraH -rA -raM, saNGacArI &c.
GREGARIOUSLY: (1) by adj.;(2) saNGaSaH (in flock).
GREGARIOUSLY , adv. yUTaSas, saNGaSas, anekaSas, gaRaSas.
GREGARIOUSNESS , s. yUTacAritvaM, saNGacAritvaM, anekacAritvaM.

details.body: GRENADE: *avapoTikA (used in a like sense in Mah).
GRENADE , s. yudDe hastaprakzepaRIyA AgneyacUrRagarBA lohagulI yA antaragni- balena SataKaRqaSo vidIrRA BUtvA ripunASaM karoti.
GRENADIER: *dakziRarakzin (m.).
GRENADIER , s. dIrGaSiraskaBft pUrvvoktAgneyAstrapARiH sEnyaviSezaH.
GREYHOUND: Svan (m.), and presented many tiger- like g.s: vyAGrasaMhananadyutIn.......SunaScopAnayadvahUn, Ram. ii. 72. 24.
GREYHOUND , s. dfzwigocaraSaSakAnusaraRe SikzitaH sutanuSarIro mfgayAkukkaraH.

GROVEL: riNgati (riNg, c. 1): v. To crawl.

GROVELING , part. or a. (Creeping) BUmO sarpI -rpiRI -rpi (n). — (Abject) nIcaH -cA -caM, aDamaH -mA -maM, nikfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, apakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, kfpaRaH -RA -RaM, aDamAcAraH -rA -raM, kzudraH -drA -draM, tucCaH -cCA -cCa.
GROVELLING (adj.): kfpaRa (f. RA): v. Mean, base.

Grow, v. i. sPuw 6 P, vikas 1 P, Pull 1 P, udBid pass. (generally of plants). 2 ruh 1 P, fD 4, 5 P, eD 1 A; puz 4 P, vfD 1 A, upaci pass., sPAy 1 A, pyE 1 A, vfdDiM yA-i 2 P. 3 saM-, jan, 4 A, BU 1 P. ‘the beard having begun to g(row)’ udBidyamAnaSmaSrurAjitayA (Ka. 29). 4 jan, utpad 4 A; ud-i 2 P, BU, ut-saM-pra°. 5 vistF pass., vyAp 5 P; ‘g(row) up’ saMvfD, eD, prOQIBU; ‘bad boys g(row) to be bad men’ kubAlAH kunarAeva nizpadyaMte-BavaMti; ‘he was grown up’, ‘he grew up to manʼs estate (majority)’ yOvana-padavImArUQaH, samArUQayOvanAraMBaH, prOQaH, prApta-yOvanaH, yOvanadaSAmApede, atIta-gata-SESavaH; ‘g(row) old’ jF 4 P. v. t. vfD c., ruh c. [Grow]ing, a. varDamAna, upacIyamAna, varDizRu. 2 rohin, ruha, ruh, Bava, udBava, praBava, ja, jAta, utTa, samutTa, BU, in comp.; ‘g(rowling)ing in size’ pra-upa-cIyamAna-avayava. Growth, s. vfdDi, AgamaH, varDanaM, upacayaH, fdDi f., sPIti f., aByudayaH, vistAraH. 2 utpatti f., saM-pra-BavaH, jananaM, janman n. 3 prOQi f., pravfdDatA.

GROW (v. i.): I To increase: varDate (vfD, c. 1.), the fish grew there: sa tatra vavfDe matsyaH, Mah. iii. 187. 12.: v. To grow up.II To be produced: jAyate (jan, c. 4.) or Bavati (BU, c. 1.), barley g. s here: yavo'tra jAyate or Bavati. Ph.: land where all crops g.: sarvaSasyapradA BUmiH, K. b. III To become: q.v.: jAyate or Bavati, grew fierce: krUramajani, Si.IV To arise from: q.v.: jAyate.
GROW (v. t.): i.e. to raise: karoti (kf, c. 8.) N. B. ropayati, saM-, (c. of ruh) is gen. restricted to planting.

To GROW , v. n. (As a plant) ruh (c. 1. rohati, roQuM), praruh, saMruh, sPuw (c. 6. sPuwati -wituM), Pull (c. 1. Pullati -llituM); ‘the lotus does not grow on the top of mountains,’ na parvatAgre nalinI prarohati. — (Increase) vfD (c. 1. varDate -rDituM), vivfD, saMvfD, aBivfD, pravfD, parivfD, saMvivfD, eD (c. 1. eDate -DituM), sameD, fD (c. 5. fDnoti, c. 4. fDyati, arDituM), upaci in pass. (-cIyate), pyE (c. 1. pyAyate, pyAtuM), ApyE, puz (c. 4. puzyati, pozwuM), sPAy (c. 1. sPAyate -yituM), AsPAy, vfdDim i (c. 2. eti -tuM) or yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM), sPItIBU. — (Extend) vistF in pass. (-stIryyate), vyAp (c. 5. -Apnoti AptuM), vitatIBU. — (Improve) AgamaM kf; ‘in knowledge.’ vidyAgamaM kf, vidyAprAptiM kf. — (Become) BU, samBU, jan (c. 4. jAyate); ‘to grow fat,’ sTUlIBU, pIvarIBU, puzwIBU; ‘to grow lean,’ kfSIBU, kfSANgaH -NgI -NgaM BU. — (Proceed from, arise) jan, upajan, prajan, saYjan, vijan, aBijan, utpad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), udi (c. 1. -ayati -etuM), udBU, praBa, samBU. — (Grow up, arrive at manhood) prOQIBU, atItaSESavaH -vA -vaM BU. — (Grow old) jF (c. 4. jIryyati, jarituM -rItuM), jIrRIBU.
To GROW , v. a. (Cause to grow) ruh in caus. (ropayati -yituM), niruh, saMruh, vfD in caus. (varDayati -yituM)
To GROW , v. n. samfD, pracurIBU, aDikIBU.

GROW UP: (1) varDate, pari-, saM-, (vfD, c. 1.), Rājavāhana grew up with the minister's sons: rAjavAhano mantriputrEH sahAvarData, D.;(2) eDate (eD, c. 1.) (rare), g. n up with young deer: mfgaSAbEH samameDitaH (tA, taM), Sa. ii.;(3) rohati (ruh, c. 1.) (of trees etc.), as seeds g.: yaTA vIjAni rohanti, Vri.
GROWER: (1) ropayitf (m.);(2) ropakaH, A-, g. of trees: vfkzAropakaH, M.
GROWER , s. ropayitA m. (tf), varDakaH; ‘of trees,’ vfkzaropayitA m.

GROWING , part. (As a plant, &c.) rohI -hiRI -hi (n), ruhaH -hA -haM, prajanizRuH -zRuH -zRu, udBavaH -vA -vaM or praBavaH -vA -vaM or BavaH -vA -vaM or jaH jA jaM or utTaH -tTA -tTaM or jAtaH -tA -taM or BUH BUH Bu in comp.; as, ‘growing in water,’ jalaruhaH -hA -haM, jalaruw m. f. n. (h), jalodBavaH -vA -vaM, jalajaH -jA -jaM -jAtaH -tA -taM, jalaBUH -BUH -Bu; ‘growing on the rocks,’ SilABavaH -vA -vaM, SilotTaH -tTA -tTaM, SilAjaH -jA -jaM; ‘growing on the head,’ SiroruhaH -hA -haM. — (Increasing) varDamAnaH -nA -naM, varDI -rDinI -rDi (n), varDanaH -nI -naM, varDizRuH -zRuH zRu, eDamAnaH -nA -naM, upacIyamAnaH -nA -naM, vistIryyamARaH -RA -RaM, vijfmBARaH -RA -RaM, ‘growing in size,’ varDamAnaSarIraH -rA -raM, pacIyamAnAvayavaH -vA -vaM; ‘growing old,’ jIryyan -ryyantI -ryyat (t).
Growl, v. i. Baz 1 P, garj 1 P, rE 1 P, durGuraravaM kf 8 U. s. BazaRaM, garjitaM, GurGuraravaH.
GROWL (v.): citkAraM karoti: v. Also to roar.
GROWL (subs.): citkAraH: v. Also roar.
GROWL , s. garjanaM, garjitaM, GurGurA, GarGaritaM, BazaRaM, rAyaRaM, rutaM.
To GROWL , v. n. garj (c. 1. garjati -rjituM), aBigarj, parigarj, garjanaM kf, GurGurAM kf, Baz (c. 1. Bazati -zituM), rE (c. 1. rAyati, rAtuM), Gur (c. 6. Gurati -rituM).

GROWN , p. p. rUQaH -QA -QaM, varDitaH -tA -taM, prarUQaH -QA -QaM, saMvarDitaH -tA -taM, pravfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, upacitaH -tAM -taM, eDitaH -tA -taM, sameDitaH -tA -taM, samfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, sPItaH -tA -taM, ApyAyitaH -tA -taM, vfMhitaH -tA -taM. — (Produced) jAtaH -tA -taM, utpannaH -nnA -nnaM, upajAtaH -tA -taM. — (Grown in size) varDitadehaH -hA -haM, prarUQakAyaH -yA -yaM. — (Full grown) prOQaH -QA -QaM, prOQaSarIraH -rA -raM, pravfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, gataSESavaH -vA -vaM, atItaSESavakAlaH -lA -laM, vayaHprAptaH -ptA -ptaM, vfdDaH -dDA -dDaM.
GROWN UP (adj.): i.e. adult: prOQaH (QA, QaM).
GROWTH: I Increase: q.v.: vfdDiH. Ph.: of one year's g.: ekavarzIRa (f. RA); full g.: pariRAmaH : v. Maturity.II Product.: q.v.

GROWTH , s. rUQiH f., prarUQiH f. — (Increase) vfdDiH f., varDanaM, vivfdDiH f., vivarDanaM, pravfdDiH f., fdDiH f., upacayaH, sPAtiH f., sPItiH f., aByudayaH, saputTAnaM, ApyAyanaM, vistAraH, vyAptiH f. — (Production) utpattiH f., utpAdanaM, janma n. (n), jananaM, prajananaM, udBavaH, praBavaH. — (Improve- ment) vfdDiH, AgamaH. — (Full growth) prOQiH f., prOQatA, pravfdDatA.
Grub, See Dig. s. kIwaH, kfmiH, koSasTaH. 2 vAmanaH, KarvaH, hrasvaH.
GRUB (subs.): I A larva: aRqaH (?).II Dwarf: vAmanaH.
GRUB (v.): I To dig: Kanati (Kan, c. 1.). G. up: unmUlayati, vidalati (dal, c. 1.), Ram. II To beg.: q.v.: Bikzate.
To GRUB , v. n. Kan (c. 1. Kanati -nituM); ‘grub up,’ utKan, protKan.
GRUB , s. kIwaH, kfmiH m., kIwaqimbaH, kIwARqajaM, koSasTaH. — (Dwarf, short, thick man) vAmanaH, KarbbaH, hrasvasTUlaH.
GRUB-STREET (adj.): perh. grAmya (f. myA) (lit. village).
GRUBBER: I A digger: KanakaH.II A ins- -trument: Kanitram.
GRUBBER , s. KanakaH, KanitA m. (tf). — (Instrument) KanitraM, KAtraM.
To GRUBBLE , v. n. anDakAre hastena parAmfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM) or AlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM) or sparSena nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM).

Grudge, v. Irzy 1 P, druh 4 P, asuyati (D.), (with dat.); na sah 1 A, na mfz 4 P, 10; See Envy. 2 akAmataH-anutsAhaM-anicCayA-kf 8 U or dA 3 U or grah 9 U. 3 pari-dev 1 A, paridiv 10 A, vilap 1 P; See Complain. s. asUyA, matsaraH, mAtsaryaM, IrzyA. 2 vEraM, vEraBAvaH, vidvezaH, cira-dIrGa-dvezaH-vEraM. [Grudg]ingly, adv. asUyayA, sAByasUyaM-serzyaM. 2 akAmataH, anicCayA, anutsAhaM, kfcCreRa, duHKena.
GRUDGE (v.): (1) dUyate (pass. of du) (= to be grieved);(2) by sAByasUyaH (yA, yaM) (= envi- -ous);(3) by vadati (= to day).
GRUDGE (subs.): (1) rAgaH: v. Enmity;(2) aBDasUyA (= envy).

To GRUDGE , v. a. and n. (Envy) asUya (nom. asUyati -te -yituM), Irzy (c. 1. Irzyati -rpyituM), spfh (c. 10. spfhayati -yituM), aBilaz (c. 1. -lazati, c. 4. -lapyati -pituM), na sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM), na mfz (c. 4. mfzyati, marpituM), mAtsaryyaM kf. — (Give or take unwillingly) akAmatas or akAmena or anicCAto dA or grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM). — (Do any thing reluctantly or grudgingly) akAmatas or ani- cCAtas or duHKena or kfcCreRa or sAsUyaM or asUyayA kiYcit kf. — (Refuse) pratyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM). — (Complain, murmur) vilap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM).

GRUDGE , s. (Malice, ill-will) mAtsaryyaM, asUyA, aByasUyA, IrzyA, drohaH, drohacintanaM, duzwaBAvaH. — (Enmity) vEraM, vEritA, vEraBAvaH. — (Hatred) dvezaH, vidvezaH, vidvizwatA, dIrGadvezaH, ciradvezaH, dvepyatA.
GRUDGINGLY: (1) anicCayA (= unwillingly); (2) duHKena (with difficulty).
GRUDGINGLY , adv. sAsUyaM, asUyayA, aByasUyayA, mAtsaryyeRa, samAtsaryyaM, duzwaBAvena, akAmatas, akAmaM -mena, anicCAtas, duHKena, kfcCreRa, kAtaryyeRa.
Gruel, s. yavAgUH, uzRikA, SrARA, vilepI, taralA; ‘sour g(ruel)’ AranAlakaM, sOvIraM, ku-lmAzABizutaM, avaMtIsomaM, DAnyAmlaM, kuMjalaM-kAMjikaM.
GRUEL: (1) yavAgUH;(2) kAYcIkam;(3) AranAlam.

GRUEL , s. kAmbalikaH. — (Rice-gruel) yavAgUH f., SrARA, taralA, vilepI, uzRikA, sidDajalaM. — (Sour gruel) AranAlaM-lakaM, sOvIraM, kulmAzaM, kulmAsaH, kulmAzABiputaM, aBizavaM, aBizutaM, kAYjikA -kaM, kAYcikaM, kAYjIkaM, kujalaM, DAnyAmlaM, avantisomaM.
GRUEL , s. manTaH. GULF, s. (Bay) AKAtaM.
Gruesome, a. BIzaRa. 2 Kedakara.
Gruff, a. karkaSa, paruza, nizWura, rUkza, kaWora, kawu, karkaSasvaBAva. 2 (Voice) gaMBIra, maMdra.
GRUFF: karkaSaH (SA, SaM): v. Rough, harsh.

GRUFF , a. karkaSasvaBAvaH -vA -vaM, karkaSaH -SA -SaM, rUkzaH -kzA -kzaM, paruzaH -zA -zaM, nizWuraH -rA -raM, kawuH -wuH -wvI -wu, kaWoraH -rA -raM, kaWinaH -nA -naM. — (As tone) mandraH -ndrA -ndraM, AmandraH -ndrA -ndraM, gamBIraH -rA -raM; ‘a gruff voice,’ gamBIrasvaraH.
GRUFFLY: karkaSam; v. Roughly, harshly.
GRUFFLY , adv. karkaSaM, rUkzaM, paruzaM, nizWuraM, kaWinaM, kaWoraM, mandraM.
GRUFFNESS: kArkaSyam: v. Roughness, harsh- -ness.
GRUFFNESS , s. karkaSatvaM -tA, kArkaSyaM, rUkzatA, rOkzyaM, paruzatA, nizWuratvaM, nEzWuryyaM, kawutvaM, kaWoratA, kAWinyaM, svaBAvakawutA. — (Of tone) mandratA, gamBIratA, gAmBIryyaM.

Grumble, v. i. Kid pass., asaMtozAd vi-lap 1 P or paridev 1 A or paridiv 10 A, vizaRRa a. BU 1 P, na tuz 4 P, vizad 1 P. 2 garj 1 P, stan 1 P. [Grumbl]ing, s. vilApaH, vilapanaM, paridevanaM-devitaM, asaMtozodgAraH, vi-zAdaH. 2 garjanaM, stanitaM, gaMBIranAdaH-DvaniH-SabdaH.
GRUMBLE: I To complain:(1) na tuzyati (tuz, c. 4.);(2) Kidyate (Kid, c. 4.) (= to be distressed).II To roar: q.v.

To GRUMBLE , v. n. (Make a low, harsh sound) garj (c. 1. garjati -rjituM), parigarj, garjanaM kf, stan (c. 1. stanati -nituM), stanitaM kf, Gur (c. 6. Gurati -rituM), guYj (c. 1. guYjati -YjituM), mandraSabdaM kf, gamBIraSabdaM kf. — (Complain discontentedly) asantuzwatvAd vilap (c. 1. -lapati [Page324-b+ 51] -pituM) or paridev (c. 1. -devate -vituM).
GRUMBLER , s. asantuzwatvAt sadAparidevI m. (n), asantuzwajanaH.
GRUMBLING , s. garjanaM, garjitaM, parigarjanaM, stanitaM, stananaM, mandraSabdaH. gamBIraSabdaH, gamBIranAdaH, gamBIraDvaniH m., gaBIraSabdaH. — (Sound of complaint) paridevanaM -vitaM, vilapanaM.
GRUMBLING , part. gamBIranAdI -dinI -di (n), mandraSabdakArI -riRI -ri (n).
GRUMBLINGLY: (1) asantuzwaH (zwA, zwaM) (= dis- -contented);(2) saKedam.
GRUME , s. gulmaH, piRqaH -RqaM, GanatA; ‘of blood,’ raktagulmaH, GanalohitaM.
GRUMOUS , a. piRqIBUtaH -tA -taM, GanIBUtaH -tA -taM, SyAnaH -nA -naM, sAndraH -ndrA -ndraM, gulmI -lminI -lmi (n); ‘grumous blood,’ GanalohitaM.
Grumpy, a. duHSIla, udAsIna, udvigna, vizaRRa, aMtaHkupita.

details.body: Grunt, v. i. garj 1 P. [Grunt]ing, s. garjitaM, SUkaranAdaH-garjitaM. [Grunt]ling, s. bAlaSUkaraH, SUkaraSAvakaH.
GRUNT (v.): g. ed loud: jagarja pariGarGaram, V. p. i. 4. 25.; where do not fierce g. ing boars g.: kaH kaH kutra na GurGurAyitaGuro Goro GurecCUkaraH, Kav.
GRUNT (subs.): GarGaranAdaH and sim. comp.s.: v. Cry.
To GRUNT , v. n. SUkaravad GarGaritaM kf or kaRWanAdaM kf or gamBIranAdaM kf, garj (c. 1. garjati -rjituM), GurGurASabdaM kf.
GRUNT , GRUNTING, s. GarGaritaM, SUkaranAdaH, SUkaragarjitaM, SUkarasya kaRWanAdaH or gamBIranAdaH.
GRUNTLING: SUkaraSAvaH, -kaH.
GRUNTLING , s. SUkaraSAvakaH, SUkaraSiSuH m., bAlaSUkaraH.
GUANO: sAmudrikapakzimalam; *gavanam.

Guarantee, s. pratyayaH, viSvAsaH, prAtiBAvyaM. 2 pratiBUH, lagnakaH, baMDakaH. v. t. Ex. by (s.); prAtiBAvyaM dA 3 U, pratiBUH sTA 1 P; ‘I g(uarantee) you the security of your property’ tvadvittarakzaRehaM pratiBUstizWAmi.
GUARANTEE (subs.): I The person: pratyaya- pratiBUH, Mit.II An engagement: pratyayaH, on my g., give him goods: matpratyayenAsya dravyaM dehi, Mit.: v. Security.
GUARANTEE (v.): expr. by pratyayaH; (2) pratiBu- rBavati (= to become surety).
GUARANTEE , s. (One who is surety for another) pratiBUH m., prati- niDiH m., maDyasTaH. — (Security) prAtiBAvyaM, pAriBAvyaM, prAtyayikaH, pratyayakAriRI, lagnakaH, banDakaH.
To GUARANTEE , v. a. pratiBUH or pratiniDiH BU, prAtiBAvyaM kf, pAriBAvyaM kf, lagnakaM or prAtyayikaM or banDakaM dA, pratyayaM kf.

Guard, v. t. saM-, pari-, rakz 1 P; pA 2 P; pA c. (pAlayati), trE 1 A, av 1 P, gup 1 P; See Protect. 2 vf c., vAr 10, ni°; ‘g(uard) against’ avaDA 3 U; sAvaDAna-avahita a. BU; See Beware. s. rakzA, rakzaRaM, gupti f., gopanaM pAlanaM, trARaM. 2 rakzakaH, rakzin m., rakzivargaH, rakzADikftaH, sEnikaH, paricaraH; vAra-RaM, trARaM, traM, in comp.; ‘finger-g(uard)’ aMguli-traM, tanutrARaM, &c., ‘arm-g(uard) in shooting’ goDA, talaM, jyAGAtavAraRaM; ‘on oneʼs g(uard)’ sAvaDAna-apramatta-avahita. a. ‘off oneʼs g(uard)’ pramatta a.; ‘g(uard)-room’ rakzakanivAsaH, udGAwaH. [Guard]ed, a. rakzita, trARa-ta, &c. 2 (‘g(uard)ful’) avahita, sAvaDAna, svavahita, samIkzyakArin, samIkzyakft. [Guard]edly, adv. sAvaDAnaM, vimfSya, avaDAnena, svavahitaM. [Guard]er, s. pAlakaH, rakzakaH, goptf m., trAtf m., pAlaH-lakaH in comp. [Guard]ian, s. rakzakaH, rakzitf m., goptf m., nATaH; ‘orphanʼs g(uardian)’ pitfsTAnIyaH; ‘g(uardian) deity’ lo-kapAlaH, dikpAlaH. [Guard]ianship, s. pAlakapadaM, rakzA, rakzaRaM.

GUARD (v. t.): (1) rakzati, pari-, saM-, aBi-, prati-, (rakz, c. 1.), and the gods of quarters g. ing (your) strength as to penances: rakzantastapasi balaYca lokapAlAH, Ki. v. 50.; was well-g. ed and well-protected like the edifice of Indra: surakzitaM suguptaYca yaTendraBavanaM taTA, Mah.;(2) gopAyati, aBi-, saM-, anu-, (gup, c. 1.), g. ed himself undaunted: jugopAtmA- namatrastaH, R. i. 21.: v. Also to protect.

GUARD (subs.): I G. ing: rakzA or rakzaRam: v. Protection. Ph.: off the g.: praBattaH (ttA, ttaM): v. Careless; be on your g.: sAvaDAno Bava, U. v.: v. Careful; to mount g.: rakzam aDitizWati (sTA, c. 1.) (?)II One who g. s.:(1) rakzin (m.);(2) rakzakaH;(3) rakzADikftaH. N. B. Use pl. when it conveys many, life-g.: aNgarakzakAH, Bha. G. -master: gulmasTAnADipaH, Mu. v.III In a vessel, a fence: AvaraRam (?)

To GUARD , v. a. and n. rakz (c. 1. rakzati -kzituM), aBirakz, parirakz, saMrakz, pratirakz, pAl or pA (c. 10. pAlayati -yituM, c. 2. pAti -tuM), anupAl, paripAl, pratipAl, sampAl, aBipAl, upapAl, gup (c. 1. gopAyati, goptuM, c. 10. gopayati -yituM), anugup, aBigup, pragup, aBi- saNgup, trE (c. 1. trAyate, trAtuM), paritrE, santrE, av (c. 1. avati -vituM), paryAp in des. (-Ipsati -psituM), pariprAp. — (Ward off) vf (c. 10. vArayati -yituM), nivf. — (Guard against) avaDA (c. 3. -Datte -DAtuM), avahitaH -tA -taM BU, sAvaDAnaH -nA -naM BU, avaDAnaM kf; ‘guard against avarice,’ loBAt sAvaDAno Bava. — (Keep guard) rakzAM kf, rakzArTaM jAgf (c. 2. jAgartti, jAgarituM).
